title: Udlejningsmægler i Aarhus
description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aarhus?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aarhus. Bemærk at stillingen som udgangspunkt er et barselsvikariat af 10-12 måneders varighed, men med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

  Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og er som udgangspunkt et barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Trindsøvej i Aarhus.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aarhus og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aarhus". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores afdelingsdirektør Niels Juul Jørgensen på tlf. 4040 2489 eller mail nju@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

title: Køkkenchef søges til Luzzo Aalborg
description:
KØKKENCHEF SØGES TIL LUZZO I AALBORG

Vil du stå i spidsen for et køkken, hvor tempoet er højt, stemningen er uformel, og ambitionerne er store?

LUZZO søger en køkkenchef, der har lyst til at tage det samlede ansvar for vores køkken og være med til at videreudvikle vores social dining-koncept midt i Aalborg.

Hos LUZZO handler det om god mad uden unødvendige dikkedarer. Vores gæster kommer for at spise, drikke og hygge sig sammen omkring bordet – med napolitansk-inspirerede pizzaer, masser af smag og et køkken, der skal kunne levere høj og ensartet kvalitet, også når restauranten er fyldt.

DIN ROLLE

Som køkkenchef får du ansvaret for den daglige drift af køkkenet og bliver en central del af holdet omkring LUZZO.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver bl.a.:

• Daglig ledelse og strukturering af køkkenet
• Vagtplanlægning og bemanding
• Oplæring, motivation og udvikling af køkkenteamet
• Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
• Varebestilling, lagerstyring og minimering af madspild
• Fokus på food cost, lønprocent og køkkenets samlede økonomi
• Egenkontrol, rengøring og fødevaresikkerhed
• Udvikling og optimering af menu, opskrifter og arbejdsgange
• Aktiv deltagelse i den daglige produktion og service

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter den længste kokkeuddannelse eller det flotteste CV. Det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar og skabe et køkken, der fungerer.

Du trives med travle services, er struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er tryk på. Du stiller krav til dig selv og dit team, men forstår samtidig, at et godt arbejdsmiljø og en stærk kultur er afgørende for at skabe gode resultater.

Du har gerne erfaring som køkkenchef, souschef eller fra en anden rolle med ansvar i et professionelt køkken.

VI TILBYDER

Du får stor indflydelse på dit eget køkken og mulighed for at sætte dit præg på et koncept i udvikling.

Hos os får du korte beslutningsveje, masser af ansvar og frihed til at gøre tingene bedre. Du bliver en del af en ambitiøs restaurant- og nattelivsorganisation, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder selvfølgelig løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV – eller skriv et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring.

Kender du den helt rigtige person? Så tag dem gerne i opslaget eller send det videre.

LUZZO – pizza, drinks & social dining i hjertet af Aalborg.

title: Kitchen Manager, Diamond Slice
description:
Dansk Version - English below

Kitchen Manager – Diamond Slice

Lokation: København (Blågårds Plads / Tagensvej)

  • Daglig køkkendrift, herunder prep, bagning og løbende kvalitetskontrol

  • Varebestillinger, varemodtagelse og lagerstyring

title: Lead Consultant – Vulnerability Management; DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
description:
Can you translate complex technical security requirements into something the business understands and acts on - and challenge where necessary?

Energinet is seeking a highly skilled cyber security professional to join our Attack Surface Management team within the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the link between the department's technical specialists and the rest of Energinet and ensure that security requirements are both understood, prioritised and complied with.

You combine solid technical insight with clear communication and business understanding. You present innovative ideas with confidence, along with the presence and authority to guide decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the operation and continual improvement of enterprise vulnerability management capabilities across IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize vulnerability scanning infrastructure, configurations, policies, and workflows.
  • Develop scalable vulnerability assessment processes covering infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud workloads, containers, and identities.
  • Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and vulnerability visibility across the enterprise.
  • Manage lifecycle vulnerability processes from detection through validation, prioritization, remediation, and closure.
  • Establish metrics and performance indicators to measure remediation effectiveness and risk reduction outcomes.
  • Analyze attack paths, exposure chains, and security control weaknesses that could contribute to organizational risk.
  • Develop risk-based methodologies for prioritizing exposures based on exploitability, business criticality, threat intelligence, and operational impact.
  • Support continuous assessment of the organization's security posture through exposure analytics and attack surface monitoring.
  • Serve as the technical owner and subject matter expert for vulnerability and exposure management platforms.


“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority.” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to
  • Have a solid technical understanding in cyber and information security and can go in-depth with technical solutions.
  • Have CISSP or an equivalent certification (e.g. CISM) - or are close to earning it.
  • Is an effective communicator who can communicate complex requirements clearly to both technicians, project managers and management.
  • Works in a structured way and projects professional authority.
  • Have business understanding and the ability to question constructively and create progress.
  • Be fluent in English at a high level in writing and speech. Danish proficiency is an advantage but not mandatory. 

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management - a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface. 

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organizational processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. 

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

title: Organist til Felsted Sogn
description:
Organist søges til Felsted Sogn

Brænder du for kirkemusik, fællesskab og udvikling? Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens musikliv i et aktivt landsogn, hvor der er plads til idéer, initiativ og kreativitet?

Så er du måske vores nye organist ved Felsted Kirke. Vi søger en engageret organist, som har lyst til at skabe musikalske oplevelser, der samler mennesker og giver liv til både gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og nye musikalske aktiviteter i sognet.

Stillingen er ledig til besættelse pr. 1. december 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale og udgør 15 timer ugentligt i genenmsnit.

Hvorfor vælge Felsted Kirke?

I Felsted ønsker vi, at kirken skal være et naturligt samlingspunkt i lokalsamfundet. Derfor spiller musikken en central rolle i vores arbejde med at skabe nærvær, fællesskab og gode oplevelser for mennesker i alle aldre.

Som organist får du stor indflydelse på udviklingen af kirkens musikliv. Menighedsrådet er velfungerende og udviklingsorienteret og ønsker aktivt at understøtte nye initiativer og musikalske aktiviteter. Vi håber blandt andet sammen med dig at:

  • Genstarte og udvikle et børnekor
  • Skabe nye musikalske traditioner og arrangementer
  • Styrke fællessangen og de musikalske fællesskaber
  • Bidrage til aktiviteter omkring vores lokale byfest ”Felsted Ugen” og andre lokale arrangementer
  • Udvikle kirkens musikalske profil for fremtiden

Kirken råder over et velklingende Marcussen & Søn-pibeorgel fra 1878 med 11 stemmer. Musikken spiller en vigtig rolle i sognet, og du får stor indflydelse på, det fremtidige musikliv i sognet.

Dine opgaver

Du vil bl.a. få ansvar for at:

  • Spille til gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • Genstarte og lede et børnekor
  • Planlægge og medvirke ved sangaftener og musikarrangementer
  • Bidrage til udviklingen af kirkens musikliv
  • Samarbejde med præst, medarbejdere, menighedsråd og lokalsamfund
Vi tilbyder

Hos Felsted Kirke bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads præget af tillid, samarbejde og lokal forankring. Du får:

  • Stor frihed til at sætte dit eget musikalske aftryk
  • Et engageret og velfungerende menighedsråd
  • Et nært og uformelt samarbejde med kolleger
  • Mulighed for faglig og musikalsk udvikling
Vi håber, at du
  • Er en dygtig musiker med interesse for kirkemusik
  • Kan inspirere både menighed, korsangere og deltagere ved arrangementer
  • Har lyst til at udvikle nye aktiviteter
  • Trives med selvstændigt ansvar og godt samarbejde
  • Møder mennesker med nærvær, engagement og respekt

Vi lægger større vægt på engagement, samarbejdsevner og lyst til at udvikle kirkens musikliv end på en bestemt profil.

Om sognet

Felsted Sogn har cirka 1.800 folkekirkemedlemmer og er en aktiv del af lokalsamfundet. Vi er et lille medarbejderteam med stærkt sammenhold og et ønske om at være en kirke, der er tæt på mennesker i alle livets faser.

Praktiske oplysninger

Du bliver ansat ved Felsted Sogns Menighedsråd, Kirkevej 17, Felsted, 6200 Aabenraa.

Der er pligt til at gøre tjeneste ved andre ansættelsesmyndigheder i provstiet i overensstemmelse med de aftaler, menighedsrådet indgår eller har indgået.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning, CV og eventuelle relevante bilag via ansøgningsformularen senest den 12. oktober 2026. Ansøgningsformularen findes via stillingsopslaget eller på provstiets karriereside: https://www.aabenraaprovsti.dk/kontakt/ledige-stillinger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte menighedsrådet via Annelise Stensgaard, als13@outlook.dk eller mobil 24764512.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt løbende.


Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen og glæder os til at høre, hvad du kan bidrage med!

Der vil blive indhentet referencer i forbindelse med ansættelsesforløbet.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen kan besættes af ansøgere med forskellige kirkemusikalske uddannelser eller dig uden uddannelse.

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter den overenskomst, der gælder for din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. De gældende overenskomster kan ses her: OK24 - Information om løn & ansættelse - Menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver - Vejledninger - Folkekirkens IntraNet.

Kirkemusiker (Dansk Kirkemusiker Forening)

Ansættelse sker efter Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 samt organisationsaftalen for kirkemusikere.

  • Årslønnen aftales inden for intervallet 333.747,51 kr. – 475.590,08 kr. (nutidskroner).
  • Stillingen er omfattet af rådighedsforpligtelse. Rådighedstillægget udgør 27.641,26 kr. årligt.
  • Derudover ydes et OK24-tillæg på 1.082,28 kr. årligt.
  • Pensionsbidraget udgør 18,4 % og indbetales til CO10 Pension i PFA.

Løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem menighedsrådet og Dansk Kirkemusiker Forening.

Organist med uddannelsen 'Kirkemusiker med Orgel og Korledelse' (tidligere PO-organist)

Ansættelse sker efter overenskomsten mellem By-, Land- og Kirkeministeriet og CO10.

Lønnen følger basislønsystemet.

  • Basistrin 1: 350.435,40 kr.
  • Basistrin 2: 368.188,95 kr.

Indplacering sker efter anciennitet.

Stillingen er omfattet af rådighedsforpligtelse. Rådighedstillægget udgør 29.665,65 kr. årligt ved tjeneste ved én kirke.

Der kan efter lokal forhandling aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg. Pensionsbidraget udgør 18,4 % og indbetales til CO10 Pension i PFA.

Løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem menighedsrådet og Organistforeningen.

DOKS-organist

Organister med kirkemusikalsk bachelor- eller kandidatuddannelse ansættes efter akademikeroverenskomsten samt protokollat for DOKS-organister.

  • Bacheloruddannede: bruttoløn mellem 332.306,24 kr. og 417.156,38 kr. alt efter anciennitet.
  • Kandidatuddannede: bruttoløn mellem 363.168,71 kr. og 442.528,79 kr. alt efter anciennitet.

Stillingen er omfattet af rådighedsforpligtelse. Rådighedstillægget udgør mellem 46.726,59 kr. og 72.572,63 kr. afhængigt af anciennitet.

Der kan efter lokal forhandling aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg. Pensionsbidraget udgør 18,07 % af basislønnen og 12,5 % af rådighedstillæget. Pensionsbidragene indbetales til PFA Pension.

Løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem menighedsrådet og DOKS.

Tjenestemandsansatte organister

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte organister har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. I så fald foretages klassificering af stillingen.

Bemærk:

De oplyste lønninger og tillæg gælder for en fuldtidsstilling. Løn, OK-tillæg og eventuelle rådighedstillæg beregnes forholdsmæssigt efter stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

title: GIS-medarbejder til Vej & Park og Natur & Udeliv
description:
Vil du bruge GIS til at skabe værdi for både natur, grønne områder og vejdrift?
Så er du måske vores nye kollega.
Har du blik for geodata, analyser og kortløsninger? Trives du med at arbejde tæt på de konkrete opgaver og skabe viden, som kan bruges direkte i driften? Og motiveres du af at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper? Så har vi en spændende og alsidig stilling til dig.

Om jobbetI Teknik & Miljø arbejder vi hver dag for at udvikle og vedligeholde kommunens veje, natur- og friluftsområder samt grønne arealer. Geodata og GIS er et vigtigt redskab i dette arbejde, og vi søger derfor en medarbejder, der kan understøtte både Vej & Park og Natur & Udeliv med analyser, registreringer, databehandling og kortproduktion.
Stillingen er organisatorisk forankret i et tæt samarbejde mellem de to afdelinger, og du vil få en central rolle i arbejdet med at omsætte data til konkret værdi for både drift, planlægning og udvikling.
Du vil arbejde med mange forskellige typer opgaver, herunder registrering og vedligeholdelse af geodata, GIS-analyser, udarbejdelse af kortmateriale samt udvikling og optimering af datagrundlag til brug i kommunens opgaveløsning. Arbejdet sker i tæt samarbejde med medarbejdere, projektledere, biologer, ingeniører og driftsansvarlige på tværs af organisationen.

Vi tilbyder digEn spændende stilling med stor variation i opgaverne og høj grad af selvstændighed.
Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Samtidig får du mulighed for at arbejde med konkrete problemstillinger, hvor dine analyser og løsninger hurtigt omsættes til praksis.
Du får en unik mulighed for at arbejde på tværs af to fagområder og bidrage til både udviklingen af kommunens natur- og klimaprojekter samt den daglige drift af veje og grønne områder.

Dine opgaverDine opgaver vil blandt andet være:
* Registrering, vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af geodata.
* GIS-bearbejdning og analyser i ArcGIS Pro og QGIS.
* Udarbejdelse af kort og kortbilag til projekter, beslutningsgrundlag og myndighedsopgaver.
* Datahåndtering og GIS-understøttelse i forbindelse med Grøn Trepart og andre naturprojekter.
* Understøttelse af vejdriftsopgaver gennem registrering og vedligeholdelse af data i GIS- og fagsystemer.
* Arbejde med analyser af grønne områder, træer, kronedække og øvrige natur- og miljødata.
* Bidrage til udvikling af nye datagrundlag og digitale arbejdsgange.
* Samarbejde med kolleger om anvendelse og formidling af geodata i organisationen.

Vi forestiller os, at du fagligt * Har erfaring med GIS og geodata.
* Har kendskab til ArcGIS Pro og evt. QGIS.
* Har erfaring med analyser, databehandling og kortproduktion.
* Har forståelse for samspillet mellem data, drift og beslutningsprocesser.
* Kan arbejde struktureret med komplekse datamængder.
* Har en relevant uddannelse som eksempelvis teknisk designer eller anden tilsvarende
* Gerne har erfaring fra kommunal, offentlig eller teknisk virksomhed, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi forventer, at du personligt * Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.
* Er nysgerrig og opsøgende i forhold til nye opgaver og problemstillinger.
* Kan samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper og afdelinger.
* Er serviceminded og har fokus på at skabe værdi for dem, du samarbejder med.
* Har gode kommunikationsevner og kan formidle tekniske problemstillinger på en forståelig måde.

AnsættelsesvilkårLøn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og principperne i Ny Løn.
Der er tale om en 2-årig projektstilling. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset som følge af projektets varighed. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres til at søge stillingen.
Tiltrædelse efter nærmere aftale.

Om osTeknik & Miljø er en af Vejle Kommunes største forvaltninger og arbejder med udvikling, drift og myndighedsopgaver inden for blandt andet natur, klima, veje, trafik og grønne områder.
Vi lægger vægt på faglig kvalitet, samarbejde og en uformel omgangstone. Samtidig arbejder vi målrettet med digitalisering og anvendelse af data som grundlag for bedre beslutninger og smartere arbejdsgange.

title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

If you are interested in working in Denmark and believe this could be the right opportunity for you, we would like to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short application explaining your experience and motivation.

Applications should be sent to: ng.sandberg@tcomp.dk

Application deadline: 10-10-2026

Start date: 19-10-2026

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

Important information for international applicants

This position is based in Denmark. Candidates from EU/EEA countries and Switzerland are welcome to apply. Candidates who require a residence and work permit must meet the applicable Danish immigration requirements.

title: Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet? No worries, vi har en plan "B" klar til dig i udlandet! Book et kald med os i dag!
description:
Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet - No worries – vi har en plan B klar til dig.

Du tjekkede optagelse.dk, loggede ind, og der stod det: ikke optaget. Surt, ja. Men lige nu har du faktisk flere muligheder, end du tror.

Spørgsmålet er bare: skal efteråret og vinteren gå med at vente på næste ansøgningsrunde – eller skal den bruges på noget, der faktisk rykker dig?

Forestil dig i stedet, at du pakker kufferten og tager til udlandet for at arbejde en periode. Varmere vejr. Nye mennesker. Oplevelser, du kommer til at fortælle om resten af livet.

Men hvad giver det egentlig dig, ud over sol og gode oplevelser?

Et arbejde i udlandet er ikke bare en pause fra hverdagen – det er faktisk noget af det, der skiller dig ud fra alle de andre ansøgere, næste gang du søger ind på studiet (eller søger job).

Det løfter dit CV markant
Arbejdsgivere og optagelsesudvalg elsker at se selvstændighed. At du har boet i et andet land, klaret dig selv, tilpasset dig en ny kultur og et nyt sprog – det viser, at du kan tage ansvar og løse problemer, uden at mor og far står lige bag dig. Det er præcis den type erfaring, der får et CV til at skille sig ud fra bunken.

Du bygger et netværk, der rækker ud over Danmark
Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med mennesker fra hele verden – andre unge i samme situation som dig, lokale kolleger, ledere med international erfaring. Det netværk kan du trække på resten af livet, uanset om det er til fremtidige jobs, praktikpladser eller bare venner, du kan besøge på den anden side af kloden.

Du udvikler kompetencer, du ikke lærer i et klasseværelse
Sprogkundskaber. Kulturel forståelse. Evnen til at begå dig i uvante situationer. Selvstændighed og ansvarlighed. Det er de "bløde" kompetencer, som rigtig mange arbejdsgivere efterspørger – og som er svære at få, hvis du bliver hjemme og venter.

Du finder ud af, hvad du faktisk vil
Mange af dem, vi sender ud, kommer hjem med en helt ny klarhed over, hvad de vil studere – eller opdager, at de brænder for noget helt andet, end de troede. Den erfaring er guld værd, når du skal træffe en beslutning, der påvirker de næste mange år af dit liv.

Kort sagt: den tid, du alligevel skal vente, kan enten gå med at se Netflix og tælle dage – eller den kan blive det, der gør dig til en stærkere kandidat, et mere selvstændigt menneske og en bedre version af dig selv, næste gang chancen byder sig.

Vi har jobmuligheder i bl.a.:

  • Spanien

  • Portugal

  • Grækenland

  • Bulgarien

  • Malta

  • Cypern

…og flere destinationer end det. Du står ikke med det hele selv – vi sørger for tryghed og fællesskab hele vejen, fra du lander til du rejser hjem igen.

Så: skal tiden bare gå? Eller skal du bruge den på noget, du faktisk får noget ud af?

title: Pædagog med stærk faglighed søges til Børne- og Ungehjem
description:
Pædagog søges til Rønnebæk Børne- og Ungehjem
30 eller 37 timer om ugen

Vil du være med til at skabe en tryg og udviklende hverdag for børn og unge i alderen 6–18 år? Er du fagligt engageret, robust og glad for at samarbejde? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog til vores team på 16 medarbejdere. Hos os bliver du en del af en hverdag, hvor nærvær, struktur og relationer er omdrejningspunktet, og hvor både pædagogiske og praktiske opgaver er en naturlig del af arbejdet.

Om Rønnebæk

Rønnebæk Børne- og Ungehjem har plads til 12 anbragte børn og unge. Vi holder til på en stor gård i naturskønne omgivelser knap fire kilometer fra Næstved centrum.

Vores børn og unge har brug for et overskueligt behandlingsmiljø med en struktureret og forudsigelig hverdag. Vi lægger vægt på tætte og forpligtende relationer til omsorgsfulde, troværdige og tydelige voksne, som støtter deres trivsel og udvikling.

Vi arbejder ud fra en systemisk-narrativ tilgang, hvor barnets fortælling og relationer står centralt. Du får en grundig indføring i både teori og praksis, så du er godt klædt på til opgaven.

Om stillingen

Stillingen er på 30 eller 37 timer om ugen. Børnene og de unge har brug for os døgnet rundt, og arbejdstiden er derfor fordelt på forskellige vagter:

  • På hverdage arbejder du primært kl. 14.00–22.00 eller kl. 15.00–09.00 med overnatning. Der kan også forekomme morgen og formiddagsvagter efter behov.

  • I weekenderne er arbejdstiden typisk kl. 10.00–23.00, og der vil til tider være nattevagter.

  • I løbet af fire uger arbejder du én samlet weekend med både lørdag og søndag samt én fredag, lørdag eller søndag 14 dage forskudt herfra.

Transport af børn og unge kan indgå i opgaverne. Det er derfor et krav, at du har kørekort til personbil og er tryg ved at køre med børn og unge.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er robust og kan bevare overblikket i en hverdag med både faste rammer og uforudsete situationer.

  • Er fagligt engageret og bringer din viden og erfaring aktivt i spil.

  • Er fleksibel og tager del i både de pædagogiske og praktiske opgaver.

  • Har humor og en positiv tilgang til hverdagen.

  • Trives i et team og bidrager til et godt samarbejde og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel for børn og unge.

  • Engagerede kolleger, der støtter hinanden i arbejdet.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på faglig udvikling og supervision.

  • En høj grad af medbestemmelse og plads til dine idéer og initiativer.

  • En grundig introduktion til vores systemisk-narrative tilgang.

  • Månedlig supervision ved en ekstern psykolog med fokus på din faglige og personlige udvikling.

  • Gratis kost og drikkevarer i arbejdstiden.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til jobopslag@outlook.com. Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder Thomas Emil Nøddelund på telefon 22 34 22 30.

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt

Ansøgninger læser løbende som de ankommer

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Elektriker søges til modulbyggeri, industri og serviceopgaver i Randers
description:
Er du uddannet elektriker, og kan du lide en hverdag med masser af variation? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter. Vi søger en faglært elektriker til en spændende stilling i Randers, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med alt fra industriopgaver og servicearbejde til boliginstallationer og større modulbyggerier.

Blandt projekterne er opførelse af moduler til kontorer og beboelse på danske kaserneområder. Her får du ikke lov til at stå det samme sted hver dag. Tværtimod bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med mange forskellige opgaver og gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Hverdagen som elektriker

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor der er travlt på den gode måde, og hvor der løbende kommer nye projekter til. Din arbejdsdag vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Modulbyggeri

  • Solcelleanlæg og batteripakker

  • Boliginstallationer

  • Service- og vedligeholdsopgaver

  • Industriinstallationer

  • Andre spændende el-tekniske opgaver

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på både kvalitet, sammenhold og frihed i hverdagen. Du kan se frem til:

  • Fastansættelse for den rette kandidat

  • Hurtig opstart, men vi venter gerne på den rette

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Gode og hjælpsomme kollegaer

  • Flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • En hverdag med plads til både seriøst arbejde og et godt grin

Krav:

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er faglært elektriker

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er mødestabil og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde

  • Har kørekort B

  • Erfaring med industri, modulbyggeri eller solcelleanlæg er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

description:

title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe?

This Is More Than a Job. It’s a Move to the Future.

title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

If you are interested in working in Denmark and believe this could be the right opportunity for you, we would like to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short application explaining your experience and motivation.

Applications should be sent to: ng.sandberg@tcomp.dk

Application deadline: 10-10-2026

Start date: 19-10-2026

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

Important information for international applicants

This position is based in Denmark. Candidates from EU/EEA countries and Switzerland are welcome to apply. Candidates who require a residence and work permit must meet the applicable Danish immigration requirements.

title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.
