title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor - Denmark
description:
About the position:
Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities:
- Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
- Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
- Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
- Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
- Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
- Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
- Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
- Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
- Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance.
- Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
- Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
- Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background:
- You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar.
- Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
- You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
- You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
- Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
- You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
- You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
- You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
- You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities:
- You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
- You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
- You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
- You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
- You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer:
- A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
- A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
- The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
- Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
- An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
- Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.

Practical information:
- Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
- Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
- Employment: Permanent position.

Application:
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://workindenmark.jobnet.dk/find-job/3d290357-17fd-4f50-9711-71a9b19dd200

title: Senior People & Culture Partner
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Impact Fund Denmark has changed a lot in a short time. We have grown quickly, welcomed many new colleagues and are becoming a larger, more international investment organisation. The same goes for People & Culture and we need and experienced People & Culture professional to strengthen our deliveries in the next phase.

The next phase is about making that growth work well: helping teams come together, strengthening leadership and building and implementing people practices that are robust enough for a more complex organisation without becoming unnecessarily heavy.

We are looking for a senior People & Culture professional with a proven track record across the full HR agenda, including culture and organisational development. You will bring experience and judgement that strengthen the whole function, with the ambition and potential to be considered for the Head of People & Culture role within three to four years. We also welcome experienced former Heads of People & Culture who want to contribute at this level as an individual contributor.

You will serve the whole organisation, where you will partner closely with senior leaders on organisational, leadership, performance and people questions. You will also take responsibility for selected People & Culture priorities and projects across Impact Fund Denmark.

You will be a senior sparring partner to the Head of People & Culture and Executive Management, bringing the confidence and experience to challenge established thinking, shape our people strategy and lead its implementation. We expect you to contribute expertise that colleagues across People & Culture, including its leadership, can learn from.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

A part of your role will be spent working directly with leaders across our investment organisation. The questions will vary: how a team should be structured, what capabilities we need next, how to address and build performance, how we strengthen succession, or what senior management needs to know before making a people decision.

You will:

  • lead culture and organisational development initiatives, translating our values and strategic priorities into everyday leadership behaviours, stronger collaboration and clear accountability for performance

  • advise senior leaders and Executive Management on organisational, capability, performance and complex people matters across headquarters and regional offices

  • prepare analysis, recommendations and decision material for Executive Management and, when relevant, the Board

  • support organisational and job design as teams, mandates and responsibilities evolve

  • advise on employee relations matters within local employment law and our agreements across headquarters and regional offices

  • use people data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and support better decisions

  • take ownership of selected People & Culture projects that cut across the organisation

  • work with People Operations, Finance and Legal to ensure that people processes have clear approvals, appropriate controls and traceable documentation, supporting compliance and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • work closely with colleagues in Recruitment, People Operations and People Development, and coach and mentor People & Culture colleagues to strengthen their business partnering skills and prepare them for broader responsibilities

We are currently a relatively lean People & Culture function. That means there is not a specialist team to hand work over to. If a recommendation requires analysis, a presentation, a new process or careful implementation, you should be comfortable taking ownership and doing that work yourself.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Change has moved beyond discussion and design. You have taken ownership of important organisational or capability priorities and helped turn them into practical improvements.

  • Core processes work well. Performance, talent and compensation processes in your area are consistent, useful and delivered on time. Leaders can explain and document their decisions, and demonstrate that people resources are used responsibly and effectively in a state-owned organisation.

  • Leaders trust your advice and judgement. Senior investment leaders involve you early as a trusted advisor and challenger when important organisational or people questions arise.

  • Decisions are better supported. Executive Management receives clear, well-argued recommendations and useful People material from you.

What we’re looking for

There is no single background that will make someone successful in this role, but you will need substantial experience dealing with the full People & Culture agenda, strategy and policy work, senior stakeholders and an organisation that has really great people and leaders with massive potential.

We would expect you to bring:

  • substantial experience in a broad senior HR Business Partner, People Partner or People leadership role in international organisations

  • experience advising senior executives directly on organisational and people decisions

  • demonstrated experience across the full HR agenda, including people strategy, culture and organisational development, recruitment, leadership development, performance, talent and succession, reward, employee relations and HR governance

  • practical experience with organisational design and complex employee matters

  • strong analytical skills and an ability to turn complicated information into a clear point of view and useful recommendations

  • evidence that you can take work from diagnosis through to implementation rather than relying on large specialist teams

  • solid knowledge of Danish employment law and HR practice; knowledge of local employment law across our regional offices is considered an advantage

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • financial services, investment or another complex, knowledge-intensive organisation.

  • working with Executive teams and Boards or preparing material for Executives and Board discussions

  • international HR

  • a lean or smaller organisation where senior People professionals remain in delivery

  • compensation, People Analytics, talent or succession

Where the role sits

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

You will be the main People & Culture partner for our investment organisation, working directly with senior investment leaders. At the same time, you will own selected priorities that matter across Impact Fund Denmark and work closely with the Head of People & Culture.

The role will suit someone who likes that combination: being in the room for senior discussions, then staying close enough to the work to make sure something actually happens afterwards.

You should be comfortable moving between an Executive Management discussion, detailed analysis and the practical conversations needed to implement a decision.

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have close access to the Head of People & Culture and senior leaders across our organisation. You will have considerable scope to influence how we organise, lead and develop our people as Impact Fund Denmark grows and consolidates.

You will also be joining at a point where the organisation is evolving. We are building the people foundation for a larger and more professional international investor, which means some things are already well established while others still need to be shaped.

And the organisation's purpose is tangible. Our investments support green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

  • We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Impact Fund Denmark has grown over the past few years, and many of our colleagues are still relatively new to the organisation. In 2027, our focus is on making that growth work well: strengthening the systems, processes and ways of working a larger organisation needs, while continuing to hire for our ambitions toward our 2027-2030 strategy.

Recruitment is an important part of that next phase.

We are creating a dedicated Senior Talent Acquisition Partner role to take ownership of how recruitment works across Impact Fund Denmark from attraction and sourcing to assessment, candidate experience and offer.

Hiring managers make the final hiring decision. Your role is to make sure they reach it through a strong, well-run and well-informed process.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

You will own end-to-end recruitment across the organisation, covering both investment roles and corporate and support functions.

For each hire, you will take the process from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to offer. You will be responsible for keeping the process moving, maintaining a high standard and making sure both candidates and hiring managers know what to expect.

At the same time, you are responsible for anchoring the recruitment process in the organisation, training hiring manager or appointed recruitment panel, and meticulous documentation of the hiring process and decisions to ensure compliance.

That includes:

  • advising hiring managers on role definition, the candidate market and the right recruitment approach

  • delivering a professional and engaging candidate journey from start to finish, including a welcoming, seamless and positive on-site experience for arriving candidates

  • coordinating, overseeing and driving end-to-end recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers

  • sourcing directly, mapping relevant markets and reaching out to candidates who may not be actively looking

  • Identifying, sourcing and vetting talents on different channels to find top-tier active and passive candidates, and conduct initial screening interviews to assess technical and interpersonal-skills as well as cultural alignment

  • screening and interviewing candidates and helping managers design structured, relevant assessments

  • managing timelines, expectations and communication from intake through to offer

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners when we use them

  • setting and ensuring a consistent standard for job ads, interviews, candidate communication and hiring documentation

  • building talent pipelines and market knowledge for recurring or difficult-to-fill profiles

  • using recruitment data to improve hiring quality, timeliness and cost-effectiveness, and demonstrate responsible use of recruitment resources in a state-owned organisation

  • improving our recruitment tools, templates and ways of working over time

  • ensuring that selection criteria, candidate assessments, approvals and hiring decisions are clearly documented and traceable, supporting public-sector governance, compliance with applicable rules and internal policies, and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • contributing to selected People & Culture projects alongside recruitment where it makes sense

  • training and guiding hiring managers on recruitment processes and guidelines to drive fair, consistent hiring decisions

We use Talentech as our applicant tracking system and CatalystOne as our HR system.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Recruitment has a clear owner. Hiring managers know where to go for advice and support, and there is a consistent professional standard across the organisation.

  • Processes are stronger and more consistent. Roles are well defined, assessments are structured, and recruitment decisions are properly documented.

  • Hiring processes keeps moving. Managers receive relevant, well-screened candidate fields, and processes keep momentum on the factors within your control.

  • We rely less on who happens to apply. Direct sourcing is used actively where needed, and external search partners are brought in selectively and managed closely.

What we’re looking for

This role needs someone who is comfortable owning recruitment rather than simply coordinating it.

You will need to bring:

  • Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment

  • strong direct-sourcing experience, including outreach to passive candidates

  • experience recruiting into a professional, knowledge-intensive environment

  • confidence advising senior and demanding hiring managers

  • the ability to keep recruitment processes moving and hold people to agreed timelines

  • experience screening and interviewing candidates, with good judgement about assessment quality

  • strong structure, follow-through and attention to the documentation behind hiring decisions

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • recruiting investment or financial-services professionals

  • executive search or other senior professional recruitment

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners

  • market mapping, talent intelligence or proactive pipeline building

  • using recruitment data and metrics to improve processes

  • international recruitment

Where the role sits

This is a Lead role with no direct reports. You will have full ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, meaning you should be comfortable balancing high-level strategy and manager coaching with hands-on execution, including the day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks, candidate care and operational execution.

You will be the main point of contact for recruitment across Impact Fund Denmark and the person responsible for how recruitment is run and for its quality.

Hiring managers remain accountable for who they hire. You bring the candidate market knowledge, recruitment expertise and process that help them make those decisions well.

That means being willing to challenge a brief when necessary, being realistic about the market, keeping a process moving when other priorities compete for attention, and making sure candidate experience does not become an afterthought.

For specialist searches, or during periods of particularly high hiring activity, you will also work with HRBP colleagues and external search partners. For periods of low activity you will build adjacent HR capabilities and part take in leadership development,....

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have the opportunity to shape how recruitment is done across the organisation rather than inherit a narrowly defined part of the process.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with senior leaders across the organisation, including our investment teams.

The role is unusually broad for an internal recruitment position. One search may be for an investment professional with a highly specialised background; the next may be for a corporate or functional expert.

And the work connects directly to Impact Fund Denmark's purpose. Every person you help bring into the organisation contributes, in some way, to investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: Up to 20% of working time from home

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

title: Inglise keele õpetaja
description:
Inglise keele huviringi õpetaja/juhendaja (osaline tööaeg)

Tööülesanded: Inglise keele huviringi õpetaja/juhendaja ülesanne on 3-7-aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning inglise keele õpetamine läbi laulude ja mängude.
Töö on osalise tööajaga, graafiku alusel ja pärastlõunal kella 15.00-17.00 vahel erinevates Tallinna lasteaedades. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, kõik materjalid, laulude kogumik, ning koolitused. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine tabelisse ning tunnist tehtud fotode saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, kõik materjalid, laulude kogumik, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Töö on paindliku graafikuga ning väikese koormuse tõttu sobib väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks.

Muud nõuded: Eriala toetav kõrgharidus (kasvatusteadused, haridus, pedagoogika, keeleõpe, lastehooldus ja noorsootöö jne).
Vajalik on varasem lastega töötamise kogemus.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

tervise edendamise kulude osalist hüvitamist; erialaseid õppimis- ja arenguvõimalusi.

erialane haridust või vähemalt 2-aastane töökogemus kokana; hea eesti keele oskust kõnes ja kirjas; täpsus, puhtusearmastus ja kohusetundlikkus; hea otsustus- ja vastutusvõime; pingetaluvus ja hea suhtlemisoskus; valmisolek ja oskus õpilasi õpetada, juhendada ning motiveerida.

title: Hotelli administraator
description:
Tööülesanded: • Külaliste soe ja professionaalne vastuvõtt (check-in / check-out).
• Broneeringute haldamine ja andmete täpsuse tagamine süsteemis. • Telefonile ja kirjadele vastamine selge, korrektse ja hooliva suhtlusstiiliga. • Majutuse, lisateenuste ja pakettide tutvustamine ning müük. • Ümbruskonna turismivõimaluste, vaatamisväärsuste ja muude lisateenuste tutvustamine, et rikastada külaliste külastust. • Erinevad kassaga ning arveldustega seotud toimingud. • Koostöö spaa, restorani ja teiste osakondadega sujuva külalisteekonna tagamiseks. • Konverentsiklientide vastuvõtt ning teenindamine. • Info liikumise ja selguse hoidmine majas. • Külaliste küsimuste ja olukordade lahendamine rahulikult ning professionaalselt. • Vastuvõtu ja fuajee üldine korrashoid ja tasakaaluka atmosfääri hoidmine.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Tähendusrikast tööd rahulikus looduskeskkonnas.
• Väljaõpet ja arenguvõimalusi. • Töötasu alates 8 eurot/tunnis brutos. • Tervist toetavat töökeskkonda (2 tervisepäeva aastas). • Spaa teenuseid soodustingimustel. • Vajadusel oma töötajate majutusvõimaluse kasutamist.

Muud nõuded: Ootused kandidaadile:
Väga hea suhtlemis-ja empaatiaoskus ning teenindusvalmidus; süsteemne, vastutustundlik, säästlik tegutsemine; hea organiseerimisoskus ja tähelepanu detailidele; oskus hallata mitut tegevust korraga; väga hea eesti ja inglise keele oskus, vene keel suhtlustasandil tuleb kasuks; arvuti kasutamise oskus (keskmisest kõrgem tehniline taip); valmisolek õppida erinevaid broneerimissüsteeme ning kaasaegseid digilahendusi; valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel (sh nädalavahetustel ja riigipühadel), Sinu roll hõlmab vahetustega tööd, sealhulgas nii päevaseid kui ka öiseid vahetusi, tagades külalistele sujuva teeninduse 24/7. Eelise annab: Varasem kogemus hotelli vastuvõtus või klienditeeninduses; huvi heaolu-, spaahotelli- või turismivaldkonna vastu; müügioskused ja soov panustada lisamüüki; kogemus broneerimis- või hotellisüsteemidega.

title: Server
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.5 - 1.0

title: Cleaner and Kitchen Assistant
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Perform daily cleaning and sanitization of all designated areas, including dining spaces, common areas, employee zones, restrooms, and storage rooms. - Ensure surfaces, floors, furniture and fixtures are kept clean and well-maintained. - Manage waste disposal, restocking of supplies, and organization of workspaces. - Conduct weekly deep cleaning of furniture, fixtures, and high-use areas. - Maintain cleanliness and organization in storage rooms and employee spaces. - Sanitize and inspect areas to uphold hygiene and safety standards. - Perform comprehensive monthly cleaning, including walls, ceilings, and equipment. - Support structural preservation efforts in designated spaces. - Provide laundry services, including washing, drying, and storing rags, towels, aprons, and uniforms. - Assist with maintenance tasks such as cleaning behind and under equipment. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, cleaning tables, and keeping the dining area tidy. - Monitor and check product freshness according to company procedures. - Follow food safety, hygiene, and occupational safety protocols, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of food and waste. - Assist cooks with basic food preparation tasks, such as washing, peeling, chopping, and portioning ingredients. - Prepare simple dishes, starters, salads, desserts, and beverages under supervision. - Clean and maintain kitchen equipment, utensils, and workstations, ensuring a hygienic working environment. - Assist in inventory management by receiving, inspecting, storing food deliveries properly, reviewing stock levels, checking expiration dates, and notifying supervisors of shortages. - Collaborate with team members, efficiently managing multiple tasks, especially during peak times, to ensure smooth operations, and assist in replenishing supplies and equipment as needed. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods by performing tasks as required by the company. - Comply with company policies, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control, promptly report issues, and submit required reports and updates. - Complete tasks assigned by the supervisor, adhering to schedules and deadlines.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - The opportunity to participate in creating a new menu and bringing your ideas to life. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Knowledge of proper cleaning methods, materials, equipment, and safety guidelines for handling cleaning agents. Familiarity with sanitation regulations, particularly in food service and public areas.
- Ability to identify and report maintenance issues, such as faulty equipment or fixtures, ensuring smooth operations. - Maintains high standards of cleanliness and hygiene, ensuring all areas are thoroughly cleaned and well-maintained. - Efficiently complete tasks within set timeframes while adapting to changing priorities or schedules. - Strong physical stamina to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting, bending, and frequent use of steps. - Maintains confidentiality and trustworthiness. - Collaborates effectively with colleagues and communicates clearly to support a clean, safe, and organized work environment. - Proactively addresses minor issues, such as equipment malfunctions, ensuring tasks are completed without disruptions. - Prioritizes hygiene, sanitation, and safety standards, particularly in high-traffic, food service and preparation areas. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - A valid health certificate is required for working in food preparation and serving areas. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.5 - 0.75

title: Senior Cook
description:
Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Professional culinary education or vocational training in cooking, baking, pastry, catering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent substantial professional experience may also be considered.
• Strong practical culinary skills, including food preparation, cooking, baking, confectionary, dough preparation and handling, portioning, and product presentation. • Experience with layered or filled dough products, pastries, or similar baked products is highly desirable. • Ability to organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, prioritize tasks, manage high-volume periods, and maintain consistent product quality and availability. • Previous experience guiding or supervising kitchen staff and coordinating work with service staff. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleaning, storage, and occupational safety requirements. • Experience with inventory, stock control, ordering, deliveries, stock rotation, write-offs, and waste control. • Comfortable using POS, inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, and basic kitchen/production management software. • Strong attention to detail, organization, leadership, communication, problem-solving, and ability to work effectively under pressure. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, trustworthy, and committed to quality, cleanliness, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.5 - 0.75

title: Reoveepuhastite operaator
description:
Tööülesanded: Kas soovid teha tööd, millel on reaalne ja puhas mõju keskkonnale? Liitu meeskonnaga!
𝗔𝗦 𝗛𝗔𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗟𝗔 𝗦𝗢𝗢𝗝𝗨𝗦 otsib oma meeskonda kohusetundlikku ja tehnilise taibuga 𝗿𝗲𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗲𝗽𝘂𝗵𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁, kelle peamiseks ülesandeks on tagada puhastusprotsesside tõrgeteta ja efektiivne toimimine. 𝗣𝗲𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘂̈𝗹𝗲𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱: • 𝗦𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗷𝘂𝗵𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗲: Reoveepuhasti seadmete ja tehnoloogiliste protsesside igapäevane jälgimine ning reguleerimine 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗮 territooriumil. • 𝗛𝗼𝗼𝗹𝗱𝘂𝘀 𝗷𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁: Puhasti seadmete (pumbad, mikserid, filtrid jne) hooldustööde teostamine ja jooksvate rikete kõrvaldamine. • 𝗞𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗶 𝗸𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹: Proovide võtmine, lihtsamate analüüside tegemine ja tulemuste dokumenteerimine. • 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗸𝗼𝗿𝗱: Puhasti territooriumi ja hoonete puhtuse ning korra tagamine. • 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗲𝗸 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘀: Osalemine valverütmis (vajadusel väljakutsetele reageerimine väljaspool tavapärast tööaega).

Omalt poolt pakume: • 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗶𝗹𝘀𝘂𝘀𝘁: Kindlat ja pikaajalist tööd elutähtsas valdkonnas.
• 𝗩𝗮̈𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗼̃𝗽𝗲𝘁: Põhjalikku kohapealset juhendamist ja erialaseid täiendkoolitusi. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘃𝗮𝗵𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗶𝗱: Kaasaegseid tööriistu ja isikukaitsevahendeid. • 𝗧𝗼𝗲𝘁𝘂𝘀𝘁: Sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘁𝗮𝘀𝘂: Konkurentsivõimelist palka.

Muud nõuded: 𝗢𝗼𝘁𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗹𝗲:
• 𝗧𝗲𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗽: Huvi tehnika, mehaanika või automaatika vastu (suureks eeliseks on eelnev töökogemus tootmises, lukksepana või operaatorina). • 𝗔𝗿𝘃𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Tavapärane arvutikasutuse oskus seadmete infosüsteemide (SCADA) jälgimiseks. • 𝗜𝘀𝗶𝗸𝘂𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗱𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱: Kohusetunne, täpsus, iseseisvus ja hea füüsiline vorm. • 𝗝𝘂𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗼𝗮𝗱: B-kategooria juhilubade olemasolu. • 𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Hea eesti keele oskus kõnes ja kirjas.

title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

Option to work from home: Yes

Tugiisiku roll on inimest juhendada ja võimestada, mitte teha igapäevaseid tegevusi tema eest ära. Töö ei sisalda hooldustoimingute tegemist.

Omalt poolt pakume: CareMate pakub:

Muud nõuded: Sobid tugiisikuks, kui sul on vähemalt üks järgnevatest: läbitud tugiisiku väljaõpe; läbitud tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe või sissejuhatav koolitus; tegevusjuhendaja kutse või vastav kutseharidus; erialane kutse- või kõrgharidus sotsiaaltöö, sotsiaalpedagoogika, eripedagoogika, tegevusteraapia, psühholoogia, vaimse tervise õenduse või alushariduse pedagoogika valdkonnas.
Ootame, et oled: usaldusväärne, empaatiline ja hea suhtleja; oskad inimest rahulikult juhendada ja motiveerida; valmis töötama iseseisvalt ning tegema koostööd tugivõrgustikuga; vajalike digioskustega; valmis oma tööd lühidalt dokumenteerima.

title: Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer
description:
**OPEN CALL FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST FOR SECONDED NATIONAL EXPERTS AT THE EUROPEAN CHEMICALS AGENCY (ECHA), HELSINKI**

Seconded National Experts (SNEs) are drawn from the civil services of EU countries. They bring their unique skills and knowledge to ECHA for a period of time before taking the experience acquired during their stay at the Agency back to their home administration.

ECHA offers job opportunities for **Seconded National Experts (SNEs)** in the following profile:

**Profile Reference:** ECHA/SNE/2026/002

**Profile Title:** Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer

**1\. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS**

Candidates for secondment must:

· Have current employment in the national, regional or local public sector or international civil service. Alternatively candidates may be employed in a non-profit or voluntary sector;

· Hold a university degree in a field relevant to the areas of work described in this call;

· Be a national of an EU or EFTA Member State or a candidate country as decided by the Council;

· Be able to communicate in written and spoken English as this is the working language of ECHA.

**2\. SECONDMENT**

The secondment will be subject to an exchange of letters between the Head of People and Development of ECHA and the applicants employer. The duration of the first secondment is a maximum of one year. This period may be renewed for a maximum of three additional years.

Seconded National Experts remain in the service of their employer throughout the period of their secondment. The sending organisation must continue remunerating the SNE, who will thus benefit from social security coverage. During their secondment, SNEs will receive subsistence allowances and reimbursement of expenses as set out in the Rules on the secondment of national experts to the European Chemicals Agency (Decision ED-0050).

The SNE Rules

**3\. PROFILE**

**Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer; ref.: ECHA/SNE/2026/002**

Our ideal candidate is a communications professional with experience gained working in a national authority, national ministry, European institution or European agency. Comfortable in a changing environment, you are adaptable, resilient and have good interpersonal and networking skills. You are curious about developments in your field and communications more broadly.

The Unit is responsible for ECHAs communications activities, including press relations, external and internal communications, social media, digital communications and its website. We focus on delivering professional proactive, clear and strategic communications services, that support the Agency's activities and promote ECHAs work and achievements.

**Job description**:

The Seconded National Expert will work in the Communications Unit – G3.

The Communications Officer will contribute to the Units daily interaction with internal and external stakeholders. The jobholder will also be responsible for relations with internal business areas on specific regulatory topics in support of ECHAs external communications strategy. The role for this profile will be assigned according to the Units needs and the jobholders competencies.

Duties will include, depending on needs:

**External Communications:**

Drafting press releases, briefings, speeches etc.;

Developing content for ECHAs website;

Dealing with press queries, interviews and briefings;

Supporting senior management with media appearances;

Organizing and supporting events for external stakeholders;

Support the production of webinars and videos;

Support the management of the Agency's corporate communication channels and social media presence; ,

Acting as a spokesperson when required; and

Working with colleagues across ECHA to determine communication priorities and key messages to be delivered to internal and external stakeholders.

**Internal Communications:**

Cooperating with colleagues in determining communications priorities;

Content development for ECHAs Intranet;

Organizing and supporting internal staff events; and

General support to internal communication initiatives.

**Project Work**

The Unit is responsible for a number of ECHA wide projects, where input may be required, including:

Building a new website;

Implementing the new ECHA corporate identity;

ECHAs 2027 Conference – 20-21 May 2027;

ECHAs 20th Anniversary 1 June 2027-31 May 2028;

Chairing the EU Agencies Heads of Communications & Information Network – 1 March 2027-28 February 2028;

**Requirements:**

Successful completion of a full course of university studies attested by a degree, where the normal duration of university education is three (3) years or more.

Of your total professional experience, at least one (1) year must be in a field or fields relevant to the areas of work mentioned above e.g. for example, external/internal communications or stakeholder relations.

Only qualifications issued by EU Member State authorities or EEA authorities and qualifications recognised as equivalent by the relevant EU or EEA Member State authorities will be accepted.

**Selection criteria:**

If you meet the requirements set out above, you will be assessed on the basis of the following selection criteria. The candidates who are judged to be the most suitable on the basis of the selection criteria will be invited to a (remote) interview.

The following will be considered as **assets**:

· Ability to communicate effectively in English at all levels both orally and in writing;

· Experience of working in a communications/stakeholder relations function in a complex regulatory environment; and

· Demonstrated understanding of the link between your current experience, the Communications Officers role and ECHAs strategic priorities.

title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

\- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

\- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

\- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

\- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

\- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

\- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

\- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

\- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

\- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

\- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

\- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

\- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

\- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

\- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

\- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

\- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

\- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

\- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

\- Scaffolding-industry experience.

\- Metalworking or welding skills.

\- Forklift experience.

\- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

\- Car driving licence (Category B).

\- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

\- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

\- Permanent, full-time employment.

\- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

\- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

\- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

title: ERP Service Manager – Wärtsilä
description:
About the role

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational cadence of Wärtsiläs ERP Application Development (Minor Enhancements). Following a major ERP transformation, our development machinery is accelerating, and we need a hands-on ERP Service Manager to act as the key operational glue between internal business workgroups and our external development partner.

You will manage the daily operations of enhancement requests, keeping monthly planning cycles, 1-month sprints, and SAP release dates strictly on track. Your primary focus will be supporting Wärtsilä's organization in operational delivery and ensuring our external offshore partner achieves high throughput and quality.

What can we offer to you
- Permanent and full-time work contract as Academic Work consultant at Wärtsilä
- Salary: about 4,000–6,000 EUR/month based on your background and skillset. For highly experienced candidates, a higher salary level may also be negotiated.
- Impactful role: You will play a central part in running the critical ERP development engine of a global listed company.
- Flexibility: We offer a possibility to hybrid work. Preferred office is Helsinki, but offices also in Turku and Vaasa.
- International environment: Opportunity to work in a diverse, global team and continuously improve ways of working.

Work tasks

You will ensure that the development engine runs like clockwork, driving operational accountability across functional teams and external vendor resources.
- Overseeing daily operational development activities and sprint cadences across functional workgroups (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Finance).
- Managing the operations for enhancement requests (ServiceNow) delivery from planning to release.
- Supporting the monthly planning sessions, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release readiness checks.
- Serving as Wärtsilä's operational interface toward the external application development lead and offshore development team.
- Managing the development team capacity based on agreed allocations.
- Tracking the application development KPIs to continuously optimize throughput.

We are looking for

Mandatory requirements:
- Strong track record in a Service Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar operational lead role within IT or ERP environments.
- Hands-on experience with agile delivery methodologies, sprint management, and release cadences.
- Proven capability in managing external IT service providers and vendor deliverables.
- Excellent written and spoken English language skills.

Considered as an advantage:
- Experience in working with Indian offshore development partners and managing cross-cultural vendor environments.
- General understanding of SAP environments (e.g., S/4HANA, Fiori, BTP) and release management concepts.
- Finnish language skills.

Who succeeds in this role:

You are an organized, resilient, and proactive coordinator who takes full ownership of outcomes. You possess the assertiveness to challenge vendors on deliverables while remaining a constructive, supportive partner to internal stakeholders.

Recruitment timeline:
- Interviews with Academic Work: Weeks 39-40
- Interviews at Wärtsilä: Week 41
- Final decisions: Weeks 41-42

Practicalities
- Location and remote work policy: Primarily Helsinki (Salmisaari), but Vaasa or Turku are also possible. Hybrid model.
- Background checks: The selected candidate will undergo a standard security clearance (turvallisuusselvitys) by Finnish Security Intelligence Service.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Semestervikariat för närvårdare, Majbergets servicehem (Borgå)
description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker NÄRVÅRDARE för semestervikariat av olika längd för tiden 8.10.2026 – 30.4.2027. Arbetsuppgifterna är förlagda till Majbergets servicehem i Borgå.**

Majbergets servicehem är ett servicehus med dygnet runt vård, där det huvudsakligen bor äldre med minnessjukdomar. Vi har sammanlagt 60 boenden i fyra olika grupphem. Vi gör miljön och deras omgivning så hemtrevlig som möjlig samt tar i helhet hand om deras välmående. Vi erbjuder dig trevliga kolleger och omsorgsfull introduktion. Vi satsar på arbetshälsa och säkerhet.

Vi uppskattar din förmåga att möjliggöra en personlig och god vardag för våra boenden genom att beakta deras individuella behov och önskemål. Vi förutsätter flexibilitet, en ansvarsfull attityd, samarbetsförmåga och en förmåga att fungera som medlem i en multiprofessionell arbetsgrupp. Vi uppskattar också erfarenhet av arbete med äldre, men det är inte en nödvändighet, eftersom just du kan vara vårt nya, stigande vårdproffs!

Om du identifierade dessa egenskaper hos dig själv, ta tag i den här intressanta möjligheten!

**Behörighetsvillkor** är närvårdarexamen eller tidigare primärskötarexamen samt registrering i registret över yrkesutbildade personer inom socialvården (JulkiSuosikki). I uppgifterna krävs goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finska eller svenska. Om det inte finns sökande som uppfyller behörighetsvillkoren beaktar vi också närvårdarstuderande i rekryteringen. För studerande förutsätter vi ett studieutdrag.

Anställningsvillkoren följer arbets- och tjänstekollektivavtalet för social- och hälsovårdssektorn (SH-avtalet. Arbetet görs i två skift. De uppgiftsrelaterade lönerna för behöriga närvårdare är 2746,46 euro/månad, uppgiften tillämpas prövotid.

I uppgiften krävs vaccinationsskydd enligt smittskyddslagen § 48 samt tuberkulosutredning enligt smittskyddslagen § 55. I arbetsavtalsförhållanden som är längre än tre månader ska den som anställts förete ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om tillsynen över social- och hälsovården (741/2023) innan arbetet påbörjas.

Sänd din ansökan så fort som möjligt, men senast 7.10.2026 kl. 13.00. Vi intervjuar och anställer redan under ansökningstiden. Närmare upplysningar ger chef för Majbergets servicehus Mathilda Rosenqvist, tel. 040 358 9922 eller mathilda.rosenqvist@itauusimaa.fi.
