title: Kan du kvalificera säkerhetskritiska elektroniksystem?
description:
Hos oss får du arbeta med några av världens mest avancerade militära fordonssystem. Du blir en nyckelperson i utvecklingsprojekt där elektronik, mjukvara, mekanik och hydraulik samverkar för att skapa säkra och robusta lösningar för användare i krävande miljöer.

De beslut du är med och fattar påverkar säkerheten för både fordonsbesättningar och tekniker som arbetar med våra produkter.

Vi söker dig som har en bakgrund i mjukvara, elektronik eller systems engineering.

Vi erbjuder dig en möjlighet att använda din breda erfarenhet till att kvalificera säkerhetskritiska tillämpningar för militära fordonssystem.

BAE Systems Hägglunds i Örnsköldsvik befinner sig i en expansiv fas med anledning av miljardaffärer. För att möta efterfrågan så rekryterar BAE Systems Hägglund tjänster till avdelningen för produktsäkerhet.

Avdelningen består idag av tio medarbetare och vårt övergripande ansvar är att befästa säkerheten i våra fordonssystem samt minska fordonens påverkan på miljön.

Din framtida utmaning

I rollen har du kontakt med ett flertal teknikområden (elektronik, mekanik, hydraulik, mjukvara). Du kommer skapa dig ett brett kontaktnät inom företaget. Möjlighet kommer att ges till dig att utveckla spetskompetens inom kvalificering av säkerhetskritiska system.

Som produktsäkerhetsingenjör kravställer du förmågor och analyserar för- och nackdelar med olika designkoncept och konstruktioner med syfte av att säkerställa att våra kunder får en säker produkt. Du arbetar utifrån vår systemsäkerhetsprocess som syftar till att skapa trygga fordonssystem för såväl egen personal som slutanvändare.

Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90) och bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10).



Du ansvarar för att

Planera och driva produktsäkerhetsarbetet framåt i projekten. Säkerställa att leverans sker enligt våra interna processer.

Arbetet omfattar samarbete med många olika funktioner såsom produktutvecklare, konstruktörer, testpersonal och servicepersonal. Du har också kontakt med kund, slutanvändare samt myndigheter kring frågor som rör produktsäkerhet och lagstiftning.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår:

- Representera produktsäkerhet i ett utvecklingsprojekts ledningsorganisation samt handleda projektresurser.

- Identifiera och analysera risker i komplexa tekniska system samt omsätta resultaten till konkreta krav på design och konstruktion.

- Dokumentera och presentera analyser gällande produkternas säkerhet, incidenter och olycksutredningar.

- Vara ledande och rådgivande i produktsäkerhetsfrågor under projektmöten och projektuppföljningar.

- Utföra granskningar och audits gällande funktionell säkerhet

Tjänsten erbjuder resor, både inom och utanför Sverige.

Den du är

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett stort intresse för teknik för att kunna få en förståelse för våra produkters sammantagna riskbild. Då tjänsten är tvärvetenskaplig är det bra om du har praktisk erfarenhet av konstruktion och/eller systemarbete inom el, elektronik, mjukvara, mekanik eller hydraulik.

Lämplig utbildningsbakgrund är civil- eller högskoleingenjör. Alternativt har du erhållit din kunskap genom längre tids praktiskt arbete.

Erfarenhet av Mil-std-882, ISO26262, IEC61508 eller ISO13849 är meriterande. Om du inte har arbetat med produktsäkerhet tidigare kommer vi att erbjuda utbildning och mentorstöd.

Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal/skrift är ett krav.

Då du kommer att arbeta både självständigt och i projektform samt med stort eget är det viktigt att du har en god kommunikations- och initiativförmåga. Du är analytisk, ser logiska samband och har ett gott omdöme.

Du är ansvarsfull och kan driva dina arbetsuppgifter med integritet och på ett övertygande sätt. Du har god förmåga att planera och organisera ditt arbete på kort och lång sikt samt kan dokumentera ditt arbete.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?

Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling.

Om du inte kan se filmen, klicka på länken: https://youtu.be/sbvv-Jm2PhI

Vad du blir en del av

Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens och karriärutveckling.

Den grupp du kommer att ingå i har en stark sammanhållning och vi stöttar varandra i arbetet.

BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har över 100 000 kvalificerade medarbetare i fler än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur.

BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90) samt bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10). Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet.

Kontaktperson

Har du frågor kring tjänsten, är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till:

Per Näslund, chef Produktsäkerhet, 0660-80967 eller Olof Salmonsson, Rekryteringskonsult, 070-377 67 38.

Vi är ett företag som arbetar med försvarssekretess. Det finns legala krav och krav som våra kunder ställer på oss som företag. Alla som anställs ska genomföra säkerhetskontroll samt drogtest. Alla våra anställda genomgår dessa rutiner.

Tjänsten är tillsvidareanställning och placeringsort är Örnsköldsvik.

title: Medicinsk fotterapeut sökes till klinik i Stockholm
description:
Medicinsk fotvårdsterapeut sökes till Stockholm – anställning eller konsultuppdrag

Är du utbildad medicinsk fotvårdsterapeut och söker en arbetsplats med ett stabilt kund och patientflöde?

Reys Medicinska Fotvård söker nu en serviceinriktad och självgående medicinsk fotvårdsterapeut till vår verksamhet i Stockholm. Vi är öppna för både dig som söker en anställning och dig som driver eget och är intresserad av ett konsultuppdrag.

Om rollen

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta cirka 3–5 dagar i veckan på våra verksamheter i Stockholm – Dalens sjukhus, Borgerskapets Enkehus och Saltsjöbaden.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en etablerad och växande verksamhet med hög efterfrågan och ett stabilt kund och patientflöde.

Upplägget kan anpassas beroende på din situation. Du kan antingen bli anställd hos oss eller arbeta som konsult genom eget företag. Omfattning, dagar och övriga villkor kommer vi överens om tillsammans utifrån verksamhetens behov och vilket upplägg som passar bäst.

Vi söker framför allt dig som kan arbeta kontinuerligt på överenskomna dagar och som trivs med ett högt patientflöde.

Vi söker dig som

    Är utbildad medicinsk fotvårdsterapeut
    Är serviceinriktad och har ett professionellt bemötande
    Är strukturerad, självgående och ansvarstagande
    Trivs med patient och kundkontakt och med att arbeta självständigt
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift
    Är flexibel och noggrann
    Har god datorvana
    Har du utbildning och kompetens för att behandla patienter med diabetes och ta emot remisspatienter är det meriterande
    Körkort är meriterande
    Erfarenhet av ambulerande medicinsk fotvård är också meriterande

Vi erbjuder

    Möjlighet till anställning eller konsultuppdrag
    Arbete cirka 2–3 dagar per vecka, med möjlighet att diskutera omfattningen
    Stabilt kund- och patientflöde
    En etablerad verksamhet med fortsatt tillväxt
    Trevlig arbetsmiljö och engagerade kollegor
    Möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med företaget

Om Reys Medicinska Fotvård

Reys Medicinska Fotvård grundades 2014 och har under de senaste åren expanderat kraftigt. Vi befinner oss i en spännande tillväxtfas och fortsätter att utveckla både vår organisation och våra verksamheter.

Vi arbetar med hög kvalitet, god service och stort fokus på våra kunders och patienters välmående.

Idag finns vi på fem verksamheter:

    Stockholm: Dalens sjukhus, Borgerskapets Enkehus och Saltsjöbaden
    Norrköping: Knäppingsborg
    Skövde: Medicinsk FotvårdsCentrum

Intresserad?

Vill du bli en del av en växande verksamhet med stabilt patientflöde och möjlighet till ett upplägg som passar både dig och verksamheten? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

I din ansökan får du gärna berätta kort om din erfarenhet och om du främst är intresserad av anställning eller konsultuppdrag.

Har du frågor om rollen eller vill veta mer om hur det är att arbeta med oss är du varmt välkommen att kontakta:

Ilia Brännström, ilia.brannstrom@reysfotvard.se, 072-2413541

title: Medicinskt ansvarig psykolog till Apex Terapi
description:
Medicinskt ansvarig psykolog till Apex Terapi

Apex Terapi söker en erfaren legitimerad psykolog som vill ta ett övergripande ansvar för den kliniska kvaliteten i vår verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som har gedigen klinisk erfarenhet och som vill kombinera din psykologkompetens med handledning, kvalitetsarbete och utveckling av verksamhetens kliniska processer.

Du blir ett viktigt stöd för våra psykologer och arbetar nära verksamhetschef och övrig ledning.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som medicinskt ansvarig psykolog ansvarar du för att säkerställa hög klinisk kvalitet och patientsäkerhet i verksamheten. I rollen ingår bland annat att:

    stödja i kliniska och behandlingsrelaterade frågor
    säkerställa att behandling bedrivs i enlighet med Region Skånes krav, vårdriktlinjer och avtal
    säkerställa korrekt dokumentation och rapportering
    följa upp behandlingskvalitet och -resultat
    genomföra regelbundna journalgranskningar
    ansvara för kliniska och medicinska rutiner samt behandlingsprocesser
    bedöma och hantera kliniska avvikelser och patientsäkerhetsfrågor
    säkerställa att handledning genomförs med god kvalitet
    ansvara för introduktion av nyanställda
    bedöma behandlares kliniska kompetens och lämplighet för olika uppdrag.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamhetschef.

Vem vi söker

Vi söker dig som är trygg i din profession och har tillräcklig klinisk erfarenhet för att kunna fungera som stöd och bollplank

För tjänsten krävs att du:

    är legitimerad psykolog med KBT-utbildning
    har minst fem års klinisk erfarenhet som psykolog
    har mycket god svenska i tal och skrift
    har god erfarenhet av bedömning och behandling av de vanligaste psykiatriska tillstånden inom primärvården
    har mycket god kunskap om evidensbaserad psykologisk behandling
    har förmåga att bedöma klinisk kompetens och behandlingskvalitet
    har god förståelse för patientsäkerhet, avvikelsehantering och kliniskt kvalitetsarbete.

Som person ser vi att du är trygg och strukturerad och har ett gott kliniskt omdöme. Du behöver kunna ge tydlig återkoppling samtidigt som du skapar förtroende och fungerar som ett stöd för kollegorna. Eftersom rollen innebär nära samarbete med både psykologer, verksamhetschef och ledning lägger vi stor vikt vid samarbetsförmåga och kommunikation.

Meriterande

Det är särskilt meriterande om du har:

    flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom primärvård
    Utbildad inom PDT
    erfarenhet av att handleda eller ge kliniskt stöd till andra psykologer
    erfarenhet av journalgranskning
    god kunskap om relevant hälso- och sjukvårdslagstiftning, exempelvis patientdatalagen, patientsäkerhetslagen och hälso- och sjukvårdslagen.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos Apex Terapi får du en klinisk roll som psykolog med samtidig möjlighet att påverka hur den kliniska verksamheten bedrivs och utvecklas. Vi är en mindre organisation med korta beslutsvägar, vilket innebär att idéer snabbt kan omsättas i praktiken.

Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamhetschef och ledning och samtidigt ha en viktig roll för våra psykologers kliniska utveckling. Ambitionen är att skapa en verksamhet där hög behandlingskvalitet, patientsäkerhet och god arbetsmiljö går hand i hand.

Vi erbjuder fantastiska kollegor, en arbetsplats med god gemenskap och möjlighet att vara med och utveckla verksamheten långsiktigt.

Om Apex Terapi

Apex Terapi öppnade i januari 2024 och ligger centralt i Limhamn tillsammans med Apex Rehab. Vi har en stor mottagning med individuella behandlingsrum, grupprum och gym.

Som arbetsgivare vill vi skapa en stimulerande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö där våra medarbetare trivs och ges goda förutsättningar att göra ett bra arbete och utvecklas i sina yrkesroller.

Så ansöker du

Skicka CV och personligt brev till rekrytering@apexterapi.se.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför kontakt från mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Solution Architect - 19660
description:

Key Responsibilities

    Set architectural direction across multiple teams, products and technology domains.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage

Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.

Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.

About the job

This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.

Ceph (block and S3) is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.

Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:

    

Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions

    

Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.

    

Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today

    

You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

How we work together:

You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.

There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.

About you

You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.

We're looking for:

    

Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply

    

Strong Linux fundamentals - the substrate everything else sits on

    

Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through

We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.

We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.

Join us at Telavox 💚

Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.

Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!

How to apply!

At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

For any questions, feel free to reach out to Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager emil.nilsson@telavox.com.

Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

title: HSE Specialist for Megaproject in Luleå, Northern Sweden
description:
NCC Green Industry Transformation

Sweden is facing a historic transformation. Heavy industry is undergoing a shift, paving the way for a fossil-free future that creates significant value in terms of economic growth, technological development, and the environment. As an important part of community development in northern Sweden—where some of the most critical investments are taking place—we are now seeking a driven Health, Safety & Environment Specialist (HSE), a key role in one of our complex projects in Northern Sweden.

The role as HSE Specialist

Do you want to help shape the industry of the future and play a key role in complex projects – in a safe and sustainable way? As a HSE Specialist on one of Sweden’s largest construction projects, you will have a central role in driving and developing systematic health and safety work on site. This is a role where your contribution truly makes a difference – every day, in the operation.

You will work closely with production and other project functions on matters such as safety inspections, statistics, risk assessments, incident and non-conformance management, and preventative health and safety initiatives. You will lead and participate in meetings, and develop instructions and presentation materials.

This role is not just about rules and procedures – it is about creating a strong, active safety culture where people thrive, perform, and return home safely. With a physical presence on the construction site, and close collaboration with the client and all project functions, you will help build both structure and culture.

You will report to our Head of Staff and become part of a committed team in an organisation where your efforts make a real difference.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with experience from large-scale projects – preferably in construction and/or industrial projects or environments – where you have worked hands-on with health and safety issues. You have relevant education or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience, and you are confident in taking ownership of your area.

You are used to driving initiatives independently and joining projects at an early stage, where you will develop and implement processes. At the same time, you work in close collaboration with the client and other professional roles in complex environments. You are proficient in both Swedish and English, and have the ability to communicate clearly and engagingly, both in conversation and in presentations.

Would you like to be part of something significant – while contributing to a safe and sustainable working environment for every individual on site? Then we would very much like to meet you.

Location

On-site presence in the city of Luleå (North of Sweden) is set to at least 50% of working hours—and at certain periods, the role will require close to full-time presence on site in Luleå. This is a prerequisite for succeeding in the role. However, it is possible to take on this exciting opportunity even if you are based elsewhere in Sweden, provided you have good travel options to Luleå (e.g., Boden, Piteå, Skellefteå, Stockholm, Uppsala, etc.). NCC will arrange travel and accommodation within Sweden.

For this position, background checks are conducted in accordance with NCC’s security culture.

Swedish Work Permit

Candidates must have the legal right to work in Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence in Sweden and limited relocation support is available.

NCC Offers

NCC strives to be an attractive employer where employees thrive, grow, and feel well. We therefore offer a wide range of employee benefits and internal training opportunities. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear terms of employment. We also offer insurance, reduced working hours, wellness allowances, and lunch benefits. Additional offers and discounts are available through our benefits portal, Benify.

Contact and Application

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Specialist Wuendy Cardenas at wuendy.cardenas@ncc.se.

Application deadline: October 23rd, 2026.

Selection will be carried out on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Welcome with your application!

Build with us and join the industry’s best team!

NCC – one of the leading construction companies in the Nordic region

At NCC, we are driven by continuous development—whether it concerns our construction projects or our personal expertise. Every day, we move the industry’s most exciting and complex construction projects forward through close collaboration between our employees, partners, and clients. With us, you are a valuable team member contributing to the landmarks that define our cities and communities.

Here, our employees take an active role in a corporate culture based on strong values and behaviors that promote a safe and secure workplace. Our combined expertise and diverse backgrounds make a difference.

We kindly decline contact from advertising and recruitment service sales representatives regarding this assignment.

title: PHE and English Teacher – Bladins International School of Malmö
description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic and committed Physical and Health Education (PHE) and English Teacher to join our Middle Years Programme (MYP) for a one-year parental leave cover, starting in January 2027.

If you are a dedicated teacher who enjoys inspiring students, building positive relationships and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you.

About Bladins International School of Malmö

Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 370 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.

As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.

The Role

As a PHE and English Teacher in our MYP, you will plan, teach and assess students in PHE and English and contribute actively to their academic, social and personal development.

You will work closely with colleagues within the relevant subject teams and across the school to provide engaging, inclusive and high-quality learning experiences for our students.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Planning and delivering engaging MYP lessons in PHE and English

    

Assessing and supporting students' learning and development

    

Creating a safe, inclusive and motivating learning environment

    

Adapting teaching to meet the different needs and abilities of students

    

Collaborating closely with colleagues and contributing to subject and school development

    

Building positive and professional relationships with students, colleagues and families

    

Contributing actively to the wider school community

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a qualified and committed teacher who is passionate about teaching and student development.

You are:

    

A qualified teacher, preferably with teaching qualifications in PHE and English

    

Passionate about creating engaging and meaningful learning experiences

    

Skilled at building positive relationships with students

    

Collaborative and comfortable working as part of an international team

    

Committed to inclusive education and meeting the needs of different learners

    

Organised, flexible and able to take responsibility for planning, teaching and assessment

    

Committed to continuous professional growth

Previous experience of teaching within the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly the MYP, is an advantage.

Since English is the working language of the school, you must be able to communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

Why Join BISM?

At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community where people genuinely care about students, colleagues and learning.

We offer:

    

An international and multicultural working environment

    

Opportunities for professional development and growth

    

Dedicated and supportive colleagues

    

The opportunity to work within an IB learning environment

    

The chance to make a positive impact on students' learning and development

Employment Information

Position: PHE and English Teacher, MYP Employment type: Fixed-term parental leave cover Working hours: Full-time (100%) Start date: January 2027 Duration: One year

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For more information about the position, please contact:

Daniel McClaer, Acting Head of School Daniel.McClaer@bladins.se

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

title: Global Technical Support Engineer
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:





It all starts with people. People like you.











Join our team



Are you interested in technical support, collaboration and product improvement?







Join our team of Global Support Engineers in Örebro! The team is part of the Technical Service department and you will be located in the Technical Service office next to R&D and Production in the Surface Division factory in Örebro.







As a Global Support Engineer, you will play an important role in helping our Customer Centers and service organizations around the world deliver exceptional support to customers. You will join a collaborative environment where technical expertise, problem-solving, and continuous learning are highly valued.



Your mission



The Technical Support team is responsible for providing technical support to our service technicians around the world.







Additionally, the role involves creating technical documentation such as training material, instructions and system descriptions as well as continuous product improvement work together with internal and external stakeholders.







Your responsibilities include:




    

Providing global technical support for Surface Drilling equipment and systems, primarily through remote channels.

  
    

Investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues together with Customer Centers and service organizations worldwide.

  
    

Supporting technologies such as electrical systems, automation, battery-electric machines, and autonomous solutions.

  
    

Creating and maintaining technical documentation, including instructions, training materials, system descriptions, and technical guidance.

  
    

Acting as a key link between Customer Centers, R&D, Production, Purchasing, Suppliers, and other internal stakeholders.

  
    

Contributing to product improvements, root-cause investigations, and quality initiatives to improve reliability and customer experience.

  
    

Supporting training activities and sharing technical knowledge across the organization.

  







The role is primarily office-based and offers the opportunity to develop broad technical expertise across multiple products, systems, and technologies.











Your profile







To succeed in this role, you are service-minded and genuinely enjoy helping others solve technical challenges. You are structured, collaborative, and a strong listener who can understand complex problems before identifying effective solutions.







We believe you have:




    

An engineering degree or equivalent technical experience.

  
    

Strong technical interest and analytical problem-solving skills.

  
    

Experience or interest in automation, electrification, electrical systems, robotics, mechatronics, or related technologies.

  
    

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  
    

The ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across different functions.

  
    

Good technical writing skills.

  
    

Professional proficiency in English.

  







Knowledge of Swedish is considered a strong advantage, as the role involves close cooperation with colleagues across several functions at our Örebro site.







We welcome both experienced professionals and candidates earlier in their careers. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate in a global environment.











Location and other



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden, and candidates should be able to work from this location. Occasional travel may occur.







We can offer a hybrid workplace - a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.











Why Epiroc?



By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.







To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    

Global career opportunities

  
    

Learning & Development programs

  
    

Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)

  
    

Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being

  
    

Global Parental Leave Policy

  
    

Community involvement

title: System Architect
description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About this opportunity Packet Core S&T drives the Technology Evolution in the Packet Core domain. Our mission is to transform industry trends, concepts, ideas and innovations into business opportunities for Ericsson.



We are now looking for a System Architect within PDU Packet Core, with broad experience in system architecture and strong knowledge of Packet Core. In this role, you will help shape the architecture across PC products while providing deep expertise in your home domain. You will work across organizational and technical boundaries to ensure that our architecture supports long-term expectations for capacity, availability, maintainability, evolvability and usability.  



The Role



As a System Architect, you will guard and drive the evolution of the system architecture across PC products. You will guide, support and follow up software development in multiple XFTs distributed over more than one site, helping teams align around a clear technical direction.



You need to actively participate in early system studies, initiate prototypes to evaluate technical solutions, and identify opportunities for architectural redesign and work packages that reduce technical debt. As well as define, secure and guard a well-defined system architecture, including architecturally significant components and their interfaces.  







Your professional experience includes…




    Prioritize the overall System Architect view across PC products while providing expertise in your home domain.  
    Participate in and lead selected Technical System Areas (TSAs) spanning PDU Packet Core.  
    Drive the system architecture evolution plan, define and deploy architectural guidelines, and keep the System Architecture Description up to date.  
    Review suggested technical solutions and feature functionality at F4, supporting Development Areas and XFTs throughout the development process.  
    Detect coordination needs for parallel development and help ensure effective alignment across teams and sites.  
    Work closely with Product Owners, system competence groups and associated TSAs, as well as customers and PDU-external partners when needed.  
    Interact with S&T to understand feasibility, influence technical standards and adjust the architecture accordingly.  
    Maintain broad product knowledge and provide the technical foundation for strategic decisions by PL, S&T and other stakeholders.  
    Contribute to technical governance for BR and PCMRP, and act as PCMPR System Responsible for selected PCMRPs.  
    Communicate the system architecture, its evolution plan and architectural guidelines, enabling developers and stakeholders to understand the current direction and coming steps.  



Please note: We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Program Manager - Automotive SW Domain
description:
L&T Technology Services Limited (LTTS) is a global leader in Engineering and R&D (ER&D) services.

We are hiring in Gothenburg!

Would you like to join a team with innovation, teamwork and entrepreneurship as the fundamental platform?

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead complex automotive networking programs focused on Automotive Ethernet Switch Validation, Testing, Debugging, and Network Protocol Verification. The role involves managing multi-disciplinary engineering teams, coordinating customer engagements, driving delivery excellence, and ensuring successful execution of Ethernet-based vehicle network programs.

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in Layer-1, Layer-2, and Layer-3 networking, Automotive Ethernet architectures, switch validation, and system integration, combined with strong program and stakeholder management experience.



Key Responsibilities

Program Management

    Lead end-to-end execution of Automotive Ethernet programs from requirement analysis to production release.
    Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risk, and resource planning.
    Interface with OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and global engineering teams.
    Drive project governance, status reporting, milestone tracking, and customer reviews.
    Ensure compliance with ASPICE, Functional Safety, and Automotive Quality standards.
    Manage multi-location engineering teams across Europe and offshore delivery centers.

Technical Leadership

    Provide technical oversight for Automotive Ethernet Switch Testing and Validation programs.
    Define verification strategies for Ethernet communication networks within vehicle architectures.
    Guide teams in debugging and root-cause analysis of complex network issues.
    Review network architectures, validation plans, test cases, and automation strategies.
    Drive system-level integration testing and performance validation.

Tools & Technologies

    CANoe
    Wireshark
    Spirent
    IXIA
    Python
    Jenkins
    Jira
    Vector Tools Suite
    Git
    Ethernet Traffic Generators
    Network Emulators

Leadership Expectations

    Manage and mentor technical leads and architects.
    Build high-performance validation teams.
    Drive innovation and automation initiatives.
    Collaborate with global stakeholders and customer leadership teams.
    Support business growth through solutioning, estimations, and technical proposals.

Qualifications

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field.
    15-22 years of experience in Automotive Embedded Systems, Networking, or Ethernet Validation.
    Minimum 5+ years of Program Management experience leading global automotive programs.
    Proven experience working with Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.
    Strong customer-facing and delivery management skills.

Preferred Experience

    Volvo Cars, Volvo Group, Polestar, Scania, Jaguar Land Rover, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, or other Automotive OEM projects.
    ASPICE-compliant project delivery.
    Functional Safety awareness (ISO 26262).
    Automotive cybersecurity exposure.
    Experience with Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) architectures.

title: Enhetschef till Parkenheten
description:
Vänersborg, regionhuvudstad i Västra Götaland, är belägen vid Vänerns sydspets och har drygt 40 000 invånare. Här kombineras fina, centrumnära badstränder som möjliggör ett dopp i Sveriges största sjö på lunchrasten med goda kommunikationer och ett attraktivt pendlingsläge.



Beskrivning

Gatuenheten är en del av Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen och ansvarar för en stor del av den offentliga miljön såsom kommunens gator, vägar, gång- och cykelvägar, parker, lekplatser och allmänna platser. Vi sköter även kommunägda badplatser, skogar, jordbruksmark och vatten. Naturvård och naturanknutet friluftsliv samt trafik- och parkeringsfrågor ligger också inom Gatuenhetens ansvarsområde. Vi hanterar dessutom frågor som rör våra småbåtshamnar och båtplatser, torg och flaggning.

Parkenheten är en av fyra enheter på Gatuenheten. Enheten är en drivande part i kommunens stadsutveckling. Vi förvaltar och utvecklar stadens parker, lekplatser, naturområden, sjöar och vattendrag. Enheten ansvarar också för vinterbelysning och julgranar. På uppdrag av andra förvaltningar/enheter utför vi även barmarksrenhållning, grönskötsel, vinterväghållning, yttre skötsel på skolgårdar, underhåll samt nybyggnation av markanläggningar. I vårt arbete strävar vi efter att ha hög effektivitet, produktivitet och kvalitet med en önskan att uppfattas professionella, engagerade och nyfikna att skapa en kommun med goda visioner om framtiden.

Gatuenheten ger sina medarbetare möjligheter att utvecklas och hos oss är det viktigt med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vänersborgs kommun arbetar vi aktivt för att skapa hälsofrämjande arbetsplatser med en god arbetsmiljö.

Är du en engagerad ledare som vill göra skillnad? Nu söker vi dig som vill fortsätta utveckla verksamheten och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för medarbetare att trivas, utvecklas och lyckas i sitt uppdrag.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter blir att planera, leda, genomföra och följa upp delar inom enheten för drift- och underhåll samt investeringsprojekt, utifrån politiskt fattade beslut.

Inom enheten finns arbetsledare, parkarbetare och kommunvärdar. Personalstyrkan varierar över året och omfattar mellan 10 och 25 medarbetare, för vilka du har personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar. Du ansvarar även för enhetens budget.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att hantera felanmälningar, ta fram skötselplaner, lämna yttranden i detaljplaneärenden, upprätta ekonomiska prognoser samt föredra och presentera ärenden för politiken.

Du är en aktiv och drivande part i enhetens utvecklingsarbete och medverkar i interna projekt inom exempelvis digitalisering, processutveckling och verksamhetsutveckling. Du samverkar med olika aktörer både inom och utanför kommunen, exempelvis andra förvaltningar, entreprenörer och invånare. Som medlem i gatuenhetens ledningsgrupp, bestående av fyra personer, är du med och driver verksamhetens utveckling och långsiktiga inriktning. Tillsammans med medarbetare och kollegor bidrar du till att gatuenheten når sina mål och utvecklas som en effektiv och hållbar verksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en trygg och engagerad ledare som trivs i en verksamhetsnära roll. Du har förmåga att skapa struktur, driva frågor framåt och fatta beslut samtidigt som du är lyhörd och bygger goda relationer med medarbetare, kollegor och samverkansparter. Rollen ställer höga krav på samarbete, kommunikation och ett stort engagemang för verksamhetens utveckling.

Vi söker dig som har:

    Eftergymnasial utbildning inom trädgård, parkförvaltning, samhällsbyggnad eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant för uppdraget. Alternativt har du förvärvat motsvarande kunskaper genom flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet.
    Flera års erfarenhet av drift- och underhållsarbete.
    God administrativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika verksamhetssystem.
    Goda kunskaper inom ärendehantering, fakturering och dokumentation.
    God förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.
    B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Tidigare erfarenhet av chefskap eller arbetsledning.
    Erfarenhet från politiskt styrd verksamhet.
    Erfarenhet av utvecklings- och förändringsarbete.

Som person är du strukturerad, beslutsam och handlingskraftig med förmåga att prioritera och skapa resultat. Du trivs med att ta ansvar och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt i ditt arbete. Du ser värdet av utvecklings- och kvalitetsarbete och vill bidra till att verksamheten ständigt förbättras och utvecklas.

Genom ett närvarande och verksamhetsnära ledarskap skapar du förtroende, delaktighet och engagemang hos dina medarbetare. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika aktörer, både internt och externt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.





Villkor

Tjänsten är en dagtidstjänst med flexibel arbetstid. Beredskapstjänstgöring kan komma att ingå i uppdraget.

Intervjuer kan komma att genomföras löpande under annonseringstiden. Tester ingår som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.

Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs innan anställning.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.



Om Vänersborgs kommun

Som medarbetare i Vänersborgs kommun bidrar du till att göra vardagen enklare för våra 40 000 medborgare i kommunen. I Vänersborgs kommun jobbar 3 600 anställda och vi arbetar för att vara attraktiv och hållbar i alla delar, hela livet.

Vi arbetar med individuell lönesättning och erbjuder förmåner kopplade till anställningen.

Vill du veta mer om oss som arbetsgivare, våra förmåner och hur vår lönesättning fungerar? Besök vår karriärsida .

Övrig information

Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund. Har du skyddade personuppgifter vänligen kontakta kontaktpersonen för annonsen via telefon och skicka din ansökan via post.

Kommunen har gjort aktiva val i denna rekrytering och vill därför inte bli kontaktade med erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp/kompetensförmedling. Kontaktuppgifter till din fackliga organisation hittar du här .

title: Thesis work - Regulatory and Operational Implications of Moving Inter-Array
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company serving approximately 12 million customers and employing around 21,000 people. We believe there is a way to build a future where everyone can choose fossil-free ways to move, make, and live.

Om rollen

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.

Vattenfall R&D is responsible for conducting business driven technical development that creates value for the company and helps us realize our strategy. We develop cost effective, safe and sustainable solutions to improve the infrastructure of Vattenfall assets including Wind, Hydro, Nuclear, SKB, Heat, and Distribution.  

Offshore wind farms are continuously increasing in size and generation capacity. As a result, the nominal voltage of inter-array cable systems has evolved from traditional medium-voltage levels to 66 kV in current state-of-the-art designs. With the next generation of offshore wind turbines expected to reach capacities of up to 20 MW, the industry is moving towards 132 kV inter-array cable systems to enable efficient power collection and transmission within wind farms.

Inter-array cables are critical assets that connect wind turbines to offshore substations and directly impact the reliability and availability of offshore wind farms. The challenges associated with these installations are significant, particularly due to the need for the highest quality and precision during installation and commissioning. Any cable failure can result in substantial losses from reduced energy production, while locating and repairing faults offshore requires considerable time, cost, and resources.

This thesis aims to assess the regulatory and operational implications of operating inter-array cable systems at 132 kV, focusing on the transition from medium-voltage to high-voltage operation in offshore wind farms.

The project will provide an overview of the regulatory and operational framework needed for 132 kV inter-array cable systems and support the offshore wind industry in preparing for the next generation of high-capacity wind farm designs.

This thesis work is for 1 student.

Kravspecifikation

We are looking for a student who is about to complete their academic studies and is eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety.

We see that you have:

title: Postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The research subject Human Work Science at Luleå University of Technology is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join an engaging research environment focused on the work environment, advanced technology and sustainable societal development. The successful candidate will work in research projects concerning the role of humans in sociotechnical systems and how these systems should be designed to support a sustainable green and digital transition.

As a postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science, you will join a research group in a dynamic research environment that works closely with industry and universities worldwide. Human Work Science at Luleå University of Technology was established in 1974 and currently has 24 employees who conduct research and teaching in both social and technical fields. Our research is highly interdisciplinary, with close collaboration between engineers and social scientists. It is often needs-driven, conducted in close proximity to workplaces and carried out in collaboration with stakeholders in wider society, including manufacturing and service companies, the social partners, and other organisations and actors in the private, public and non-profit sectors. Our projects cover areas such as industry (mining, forestry, steel and construction), health and medical care, education and retail. Organisationally, Human Work Science is part of the Division of Human and Technology, within the Department of Social Sciences, Technology and Arts at Luleå University of Technology. More information is available on our website: www.ltu.se/arbetsvetenskap.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will have excellent opportunities over two years to develop your academic qualifications in our research subject, primarily through research but also through teaching.



Subject description

Human Work Science includes research on work environment, technology and production systems, work organization, and/or other social processes from humans' conditions and needs in order to create safe and attractive work and socially sustainable development in working life, industry and society.



Project description

As a postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science, you will primarily work in a research project that aims to develop new knowledge about how AR can support work in underground mines. The project aims to develop and implement Augmented Reality (AR)-based maintenance support for drill rigs. Its objective is to optimise human-technology interaction to improve the efficiency, safety and precision of maintenance processes in the mining industry. The project integrates advanced AR technology with comprehensive change-management strategies and user-centred UX work to support successful implementation and adoption. By combining Epiroc's technical expertise, Boliden's operational experience and academic research, the project seeks to create a solution that is not only technically innovative but also practically useful and well received by maintenance personnel. The work focuses on identifying critical information, optimising how maintenance instructions and training materials are presented, and determining key parameters for improved maintenance. The expected outcomes are more efficient maintenance processes, improved safety, fewer operational disruptions and a better user experience, contributing in turn to greater sustainability and competitiveness in the Swedish mining industry.



Duties

The duties of a postdoctoral researcher primarily involve research. Teaching and educational development may account for no more than 20 per cent of working time. You will participate in and actively contribute to collaboration with national and international partners and with research groups both within and outside Luleå University of Technology. You will also have the opportunity to apply for external research funding.



Qualifications

In order to be eligible for employment as postdoctoral researcher you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Human Work Science or a closely related research field. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.

We would also welcome applicants who have

    very good knowledge of both qualitative and quantitative methods
    experience of independently applying for competitive research funding
    experience of leading projects or working groups

Good oral and written communication skills in Swedish or English are required.

Considerable weight will also be given to personal suitability. Desirable personal qualities include good collaboration skills, initiative, an interest in development work, and the ability and motivation to pursue an academic career.



Information

This is a full-time position for two years with the possibility of extension for up to three years, based in Luleå. The intended starting date is 1 November 2026.

title: Head of European Outbound Logistics
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Supply Chain function drives Volvo Cars’ end-to-end business by planning and delivering a high-performing, strategic supply chain that aligns with the company’s goals of profitability, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.







Outbound Logistics EMEA and Intercontinental encompasses both global and regional responsibilities. Our mission is to manage logistics operations between all regions  (IC) and within Europe—from import ports and European production plants to dealerships.We design and operate a sustainable and resilient distribution network, focusing on cost efficiency and greenhouse gas reduction through responsible sourcing. We drive transformation projects to enhance future excellence in both systems and processes.









     What you'll do  

The Head of European Outbound Logistics is accountable for leading the end-to-end outbound logistics organisation across Europe, ensuring that finished vehicles or products are delivered to customers, markets, retailers, and onward distribution points with the right balance of service performance, cost efficiency, resilience, sustainability, and quality. The role reports to the Global Head of Supply Chain and acts as the regional owner for outbound logistics execution, capability development, and transformation across the European network.







You are to define and execute the European outbound logistics strategy in alignment with the global supply chain strategy, commercial priorities, manufacturing plans, and customer promise. You will own regional outbound logistics performance across service, quality, cost, lead time, capacity, sustainability, and resilience.







You will lead operational governance with transport providers, compounds, ports, terminals, hubs, and other logistics partners, ensuring clear accountability, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. You will also build a high-performing organisation with clear roles, succession planning, capability development, and strong leadership routines across the four organisational pillars.







You will secure capacity and readiness for volume changes, launches, seasonal peaks, market shifts, and disruption scenarios. You are to drive structural cost improvements through network optimisation, carrier strategy, productivity, tender support, improved utilisation, and reduction of premium or avoidable transport costs.







You are to ensure robust escalation management for service failures, capacity constraints, quality deviations, system issues, and major network disruptions. You will lead the digital and data agenda for European outbound logistics, improving visibility, decision quality, automation, and performance management. You will also embed sustainability into transport decisions, including modal shift opportunities, emissions reduction, capacity efficiency, and supplier performance expectations.







You will represent European outbound logistics in global supply chain forums, executive reviews, cross-functional governance, and transformation programmes.









     What you'll bring  

You would bring significant senior leadership experience in outbound logistics, transport operations, distribution, supply chain, or finished goods logistics, preferably in a pan-European or global environment.







This role requires previous experience and a track record in both closely communicating (i.e. Mandarin language proficiency) and working with Stakeholders in China. You are fluent in English communication skills; additional European languages are an advantage. Volvo Cars working experience is also of meritorious.







You bring proven experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and managing through managers, specialists, and operational leads. You bring strong understanding of road transport operations, intercontinental logistics flows, carrier management, logistics engineering, and transport management systems. You have demonstrated ability to lead transformation, network optimisation, digitalisation, cost improvement, and operational performance recovery. You also bring strong commercial understanding, including logistics cost drivers, tendering, supplier governance, contract performance, and budget ownership.







You are highly analytical capability with the ability to translate data into decisions, priorities, and executive-level recommendations. You have excellent stakeholder management skills across senior leadership, markets, manufacturing, procurement, finance, IT, and external partners.







You would bring key leadership skills by providing visible, calm, and fact-based leadership in a complex regional logistics environment. You balance strategic transformation with strong operational discipline and daily execution control. Create clarity across functions, geographies, and partners by setting priorities, decision rights, and performance expectations. Develop leaders and specialists who can manage complexity, challenge performance, and drive improvement with confidence. Act as a trusted regional counterpart to global supply chain leadership, translating business needs into practical logistics solutions.

Department of Clinical Sciences

The University Animal Hospital (UDS) at the Department of Clinical Sciences (KV), serves as SLU's centre for clinical research and education. The management team promotes a forward-thinking and supportive environment, encouraging employees to develop their skills and pursue their interests through ongoing professional development. We are now seeking a clinically active veterinarian with broad experience in small animal practise and anaesthesiology. Welcome with your application!

In your day-to-day role, you will be actively involved in the clinical teaching of veterinary students, interns, and residents. You will also provide guidance and support to veterinary nurses.

Opportunities to engage in ongoing clinical research are available, and you may also contribute to lecturing, small group teaching, and assessing veterinary students. A crucial aspect of your work will involve advising and collaborating with veterinarians in other disciplines, such as intensive care and in patient care. Regular consultations with veterinarians, including referral veterinarians, are an integral part of this role.

Your profile

You have veterinary credentials from a university in Sweden or another EU/EEA country or in Switzerland and is eligible to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden.

It is a merit, but not a requirement, if you hold credentials as an EBVS® European Veterinary Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia (or ACVAA board-certified specialist). Teaching and/or research experience in the field is considered merits.

Proficiency in English is required, and you either speak a Scandinavian language or are committed to learning Swedish within a time-period of ca 2-3 years.

Significant emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. We value a professional approach and expect you to be flexible, appreciate teamwork, and contribute to the smooth operation of the surgical department.

About us

The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities within all these fields encompass all animal species.

At the SLU University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate tomorrow’s veterinarians and veterinary nurses and provide first-class care for companion animals, competition animals and production animals. We also share knowledge with the general public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are developing the veterinary care of the future.

Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern, purpose-built facilities, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging and a specialist veterinary laboratory.

title: Research Engineer in Analytical Chemistry and Metabolomics
description:
Do you enjoy hands-on analytical chemistry and working with advanced mass spectrometry? At Chalmers Mass Spectrometry Infrastructure (CMSI), you will contribute to a wide range of life science research projects by performing high-quality targeted and untargeted metabolomics analyses. This is a hands-on laboratory role for an analytical chemist who enjoys working systematically, maintaining high quality standards and contributing as part of a collaborative infrastructure team.

Information about the division/project

Chalmers Mass Spectrometry Infrastructure (CMSI) is part of the Division of Infrastructures at the Department of Life Sciences, Chalmers University of Technology. CMSI provides advanced mass spectrometry-based analytical services and expertise, with a particular focus on metabolomics and lipidomics.

We support research projects from academia, healthcare and industry and offer both targeted quantitative metabolomics and untargeted metabolomics workflows. CMSI is also part of the national Metabolomics and Exposomics Platform within SciLifeLab. You will join a team with complementary expertise in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, metabolomics and data analysis.

You will conllaborate with researchers and users from a broad range of disciplines and contribute analyses that support cutting-egde research.

Job Description

Your main responsibility will be to perform high-quality analytical work using established targeted and untargeted metabolomics workflows at CMSI. Your tasks will include: •Sample preparation for targeted and untargeted metabolomics analyses.•LC-MS analysis using established CMSI workflows.•Operation and monitoring of LC-MS/MS and LC-HRMS instrumentation.•Routine quality control and assessment of analytical performance.•Documentation of laboratory work and analytical results.•Contribution to instrument maintenance, troubleshooting, SOPs and quality documentation.•General laboratory activities required for reliable and efficient operation of the infrastructure.•Close collaboration with other CMSI staff in the execution of analytical projects.



The focus of the position is on running and ensuring the quality of established analytical workflows. You may also contribute to continuous improvement of existing workflows, while development of new analytical methods is not a primary responsibility of the role.

Contract terms

Temporary employment until 31 October, 2027. Preferable starting date: 1 November, 2026.

Qualifications

We are looking for one-two analytical chemists who enjoy practical laboratory work and have a strong interest in mass spectrometry. The following qualifications are required: •MSc in analytical chemistry, or an equivalent degree with a strong focus on analytical chemistry.•Hands-on experience of LC-MS-based analytical work.•Practical experience of sample preparation and instrumental analysis.•Good understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry.•Ability to independently perform and document laboratory work.•Good written and spoken English. The following qualifications are considered meritorious: •Experience in targeted and/or untargeted metabolomics.•Experience with UHPLC-MS/MS and/or UHPLC-HRMS systems.•Experience of independently operating and troubleshooting LC-MS instrumentation.•Experience in quantitative bioanalysis.•Experience in systematic quality assurance work, including SOPs and analytical documentation.•Experience of working with large sample series.•Experience from a research infrastructure, core facility or other service-oriented analytical laboratory.•PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related field. You are quality-conscious, systematic and structured, and and enjoy working carefully and reproducibly according to established quality procedures. You are able to work independently while also collaborating closely with colleagues and contributing to common priorities within the team. As CMSI is a research infrastructure supporting many different projects and users, we also value a service-oriented approach and good problem-solving skills.

What we offer

Chalmers provides a cultivating and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.



Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.





Chalmers aims to actively improve our gender balance. We work broadly with equality projects, for example the GENIE Initiative on gender equality for excellence. Equality and diversity are substantial foundations in all activities at Chalmers.



Application procedure

The application should be attached as PDF files, as below:





CV



Other documents (optional):



• Copies of completed education, grades etc.





In this recruitment, personal letters are replaced by selection questions related to the position. We therefore ask you to answer the selection questions in the application instead of attaching a personal letter. Any attached personal letter will not be considered in the selection process.





A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.





Please use the button at the bottom of the page to reach the application form. We do not accept applications sent by email.



Application deadline: October 7, 2026





For questions, please contact:



Head of Division, Malin Barman, Division of Infrastructures, CMSI, malin.barman@chalmers.se



Lab manager, Julia Karlsson, Division of Infrastructures, CMSI, julia.karlsson@chalmers.se





*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***





Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.



Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.

title: Paid Social Manager
description:
Publicis Groupe is one of the largest communications groups in the world. We are building the agency model of the future and take a holistic approach to our clients’ challenges. By fusing together our media, creative, data and technology expertise, we are able to provide clients with integrated solutions, transformative ideas and compelling consumer experiences. We call it the Power of One.

We are proud winner of many awards and nominations, both in Sweden and internationally. But nothing makes us prouder than to work with clients and brands such as P&G, Disney, H&M, Mondelez, Volvo, VISA, Lantmännen, LEGO, Spotify, Perrigo, Renault and many more.

At Publicis, we put our people first. We are proud to be certified by Great Place to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) and have won the Diversity Charter Sweden Awards in the category Mental Health (2025). We have also been recognized with a Magnet Award for our engaging culture (2023). Our goal is to become the leading workplace in our industry. We are based in two fantastic offices in Vasastan – Odenplan and Upplandsgatan – and offer a flexible work policy.

We are currently looking for a Paid Social Manager to join our team. In this role, you will work alongside project managers to execute impactful campaigns across various social media channels, including Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, Pinterest, and others.

Your responsibilities will include ongoing social media purchasing, from strategizing and providing recommendations to setting up campaigns, optimizing them, analyzing their performance, and reporting on them. You will also be responsible for the following:

    Dynamic advertising and social commerce
    Developing and implementing strategies across social media platforms
    Designing dynamic campaign strategies for our clients
    Creating tactical and dynamic campaign recommendations for paid social media
    Planning, purchasing, optimizing, and continually reporting on social media campaigns, primarily for larger global accounts
    Managing campaigns using self-service tools for purchasing, optimization, and campaign management
    Building and maintaining dynamic feeds
    Analyzing and evaluating campaign results based on predefined goals
    Performing various administration tasks related to campaigns and customer work

Skills and qualifications required for this position include:

    Academic or relevant post-secondary education in marketing
    Proven experience in paid social media, whether on the agency or client side
    A customer-focused approach, ensuring that ad campaigns align with the target audience's needs and interests
    Strong written and verbal communication skills for client interaction, reporting, and team collaboration
    A natural curiosity to stay updated on social media trends and industry changes
    The ability to identify issues with ad campaigns and recommend solutions promptly
    A collaborative mindset, working effectively with a team, clients, and other marketing professionals
    Proficiency in the Smartly platform is a plus

In addition to a welcoming culture and inclusive environment with passionate colleagues we offer you:

Career Opportunities

Local and Global opportunities through the Power Of One.

Personal and Professional Learning

Global AI learning platform where you can participate in +30 000 classes and connect with colleagues from all over the world.

Flexible Ways of Working

We want to be an employer where work life balance is cherished. We love to spend time with our colleagues at the office but also believe in the output of your work not where the work is being done.

Work Your World

For six weeks a year, the world is yours. Every employee can work anywhere on the planet where there's a Publicis office. A new city, a favorite locale, or even a different country - Go. Grow. Explore.

Mental Health

The happiness and health of our people is paramount to us. We work continuously on maintaining a healthy and safe working environment through initiatives that facilitate the well-being of our employees.

Benefits

Generous benefit package.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:





Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

    What you will do  

The mission of this assignment is to develop and maintain applications that are used by different truck divisions within Volvo Group. The applications are mainly backend C++ applications that provide truck unique parameters and BOM for end users to perform technical calculations, for factories to build trucks, or for sales to specify orders. We are looking for person with an engineering background specialized in simulation/calculation to focus om our CAE related applications

Self-motivated person to work independentlyStrong team spirit to cooperate with team members, share ideas and help each otherStrong agile mindset and positive to accept rapid changesExperience in Scrum manifesto Proactive thinking to build high quality, robust, and scalable software applications

     Required Skills:  

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experiences on C++, Node.js, Javascript/JQuery/Bootstrap, ACPS, Oracle, Containerization (docker), RESTAPI, PythonVersion control: GIT, CI/CD, message queue concept (e.g. IBM MQ)







Last application date is 6/10-26







Union representatives for Swedish applicants:



Akademikerna – Mikael Johansson, +46 73 902 34 30



Unionen – Lajla Dahlsjö, +46 31 322 45 75



Ledarna – Carina Sachade, +46 73 902 40 83

Who we are and what we believe in



We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.



Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.







Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO) is a new division. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.







Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world.
