title: Production Support Engineer
description:
When you can’t breathe, nothing else matters. That’s why a career at Breas Medical matters.

Our mission is to improve the quality of life and care of respiratory patients around the world through a personal commitment to innovation, quality and customer focus.

Are you our next Production Support Engineer?

Are you an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and turning ideas into reliable manufacturing solutions? You may already have experience in production or manufacturing engineering, or you may be at the beginning of your career with a relevant technical education and an interest in medical technology.

As a Production Support Engineer within R&D Sweden, you will play an important role in strengthening our production processes and supporting the introduction of new products and design changes. Working closely with Production, R&D, Quality and other cross-functional teams, you will help ensure that our products are manufactured safely, efficiently and in accordance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on production support with continuous improvement, technical problem-solving and long-term development in a highly regulated and meaningful industry.

The position is full-time, permanent and based on-site at Breas Medical’s headquarters in Mölnlycke, Sweden.

Main responsibilities

    

Provide technical support to Production and help resolve manufacturing and quality-related issues.

    

Lead or support design transfers, new product introductions and the implementation of design changes.

    

Develop and improve manufacturing processes, methods, tooling, equipment and work instructions.

    

Plan, perform and document process, verification and validation activities.

    

Analyse production performance and contribute to improvements in product quality, production yield, safety and cost efficiency.

    

Support Lean initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.

About you

You are a curious and solutions-oriented engineer who enjoys turning technical challenges into practical improvements. You work in a structured way, with attention to quality, safety and documentation.

Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you are comfortable communicating with colleagues across different functions and areas of expertise. You have an open mindset, enjoy working close to production and are motivated by contributing to products and processes that make a meaningful difference.

To be successful in this role, we believe you bring some of the following experience and skills:

    

A university degree in production engineering, medical engineering, mechanical engineering, electronics or another relevant technical field.

    

Experience or a strong interest in production, manufacturing processes or medical technology.

    

An understanding of mechanics, electronics and software, and how these areas interact within a product.

    

Experience or knowledge of Design for Manufacturing, design transfer, verification, validation, tooling or process development.

    

A structured approach to problem-solving and technical documentation.

    

Good spoken and written Swedish and English.

Previous experience in production or manufacturing engineering is an advantage but not essential. We also welcome applications from recent graduates with a relevant educational background and an interest in developing within production engineering and medical technology.

Knowledge of regulatory requirements and standards for medical devices, such as ISO 13485, MDR, IEC 60601-1 or FDA requirements, is considered an advantage.

Be More with us

Join Breas and become part of a company where your experience, ideas and ambition can make a meaningful difference. Apply today and explore what it means to Be More.

Expected recruitment timeline

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

More about us

Founded in 1991 in Gothenburg, Sweden, Breas Medical is a global specialist in home mechanical ventilation and airway clearance, with a growing portfolio of sleep therapy solutions.

Our purpose is to help the world breathe better. We connect people throughout the respiratory journey by bringing together insights, innovation and care. Our solutions form a connected ecosystem that includes ventilation, airway clearance, interfaces, accessories, connectivity, services and clinical education, supporting patients, caregivers and healthcare professionals from therapy initiation to long-term care at home.

Headquartered in Sweden, Breas has more than 300 employees and subsidiaries across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. Together with our network of specialised distributors, we serve customers in over 40 countries worldwide.

Find out more:

    

Breas Medical

title: Mekanikkonstruktör
description:
Multiply Teknik & IT AB växer och söker nu en mekanikkonstruktör.

Multiply är Stockholms baserat företag och växer i Västmanland.

Du kommer att arbeta hos en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom försvars- och säkerhetsindustrin, där avancerade tekniska system utvecklas i en projektdriven och högteknologisk miljö.

Om rollen

Som mekanikkonstruktör blir du en del av ett erfaret konstruktionsteam där du arbetar med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling av avancerade produkter. Rollen innebär ett helhetsansvar genom utvecklingskedjan och ett nära samarbete med produktion, projektledning och andra tekniska funktioner.

Vi söker dig som har

    Ingenjörsutbildning eller motsvarande teknisk bakgrund
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion
    Erfarenhet av CAD-verktyg såsom Inventor, AutoCAD eller SolidWorks
    Erfarenhet av arbete i PLM/PDM-system
    Goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift (krav)
    Svenskt medborgarskap (krav)
    Godkänd säkerhetsprövning (krav)

Du har en god teknisk förståelse och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i en projektdriven miljö.

Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att samarbeta tvärfunktionellt.

Om du är bosatt på annan ort erbjuder vi en lägenhet i Västmanland som en del av anställningen.

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet av att driva projekt
    Erfarenhet från försvars-, flyg- eller fordonsindustrin
    Grundläggande kunskap inom el/elektronik

Om Multiply Teknik & IT AB

Multiply Teknik & IT AB är en teknikdriven end-to-end solution provider som verkar i gränslandet mellan systemutveckling, teknisk konstruktion och datadrivna plattformar. Vi hjälper organisationer att utveckla, integrera och vidareutveckla komplexa tekniska system inom säkerhetskritiska och avancerade industriella miljöer.

Vi utvecklar även vår egen produkt VisFlow (visflow.io) – en plattform som hjälper organisationer att skapa insikt och styrning genom visualisering, simulering och analys av komplexa flöden. Det innebär att Multiply kombinerar:

    avancerade kundprojekt

    egen produktutveckling

    och kunskapsleverans i form av utbildningar

Hos oss blir du en del av ett växande team där vi värdesätter teknisk nyfikenhet, samarbete och långsiktig kompetensutveckling.

Kulturen på Multiply bygger på tre grundpelare: karaktär, engagemang och kompetens. Hur du tar ansvar, samarbetar och utvecklas är minst lika viktigt som din tekniska bakgrund.

I slutändan handlar Multiply om att kombinera tre saker:

    Avancerad teknik
    Djup verksamhets- och systemförståelse
    Möjligheten att bygga långsiktiga och hållbara lösningar

title: Production Engineer  Process, Product, Assignment or Lead
description:
At Multiply, you become part of a technology-driven company combining advanced customer projects, product development, and competence building.

Multiply is an end-to-end provider of products, services, and training within engineering, automation, embedded systems, functional safety, cybersecurity, electronics, and advanced product development. Through our VisFlow platform, we also support structured development, operational visibility, compliance, and lifecycle governance across complex industrial environments.

About the Role

We are continuously looking for Production Engineers, Industrialization Engineers, Process Engineers, Product Engineers, and Technical Leads who want to develop robust, efficient, and sustainable production environments.

Depending on your background and the assignment, you may work with daily production support, process development, industrialization, product introduction, technical project leadership, or strategic production improvements.

Your responsibilities may include:

    Leading industrialization from prototype and pre-series phases to stable series production
    Developing and optimizing production processes, production flows, layouts, and working methods
    Supporting NPI, product introduction, production ramp-up, and manufacturing readiness

    Planning and coordinating production equipment, technical installations, and process changes
    Defining technical requirements for equipment, suppliers, and production solutions
    Participating in technical reviews of equipment, processes, layouts, safety, quality, and ergonomics
    Supporting automation, digitalization, Industry 4.0, and cost-reduction initiatives
    Developing standardized production methods, documentation, instructions, and best practices

For senior profiles, the role may also include leading industrialization projects, coordinating technical workstreams, managing stakeholders, mentoring colleagues, and driving both operational and strategic improvement initiatives.

Your Profile

We welcome experienced Production Engineers as well as senior specialists and technical leaders.

You likely have experience within one or more of the following areas:

    Production engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or product engineering
    Industrialization from prototype to series production
    Production development, NPI, ramp-up, or manufacturing readiness
    Layout planning, flow optimization, capacity planning, and resource planning

    Root-cause analysis, risk management, and quality-controlled production
    Technical project management or cross-functional coordination
    Production equipment, technical installations, tooling, or manufacturing processes

Experience with the following is considered valuable:

    CAD and production-layout tools
    ERP, MRP, or SAP environments
    MES and production management systems
    Automation, robotics, and Industry 4.0
    Supplier coordination and technical procurement
    FAT, SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up
    Ergonomics, workplace design, and production safety

For senior assignments, approximately 8–15+ years of relevant experience may be required. Some specialist and lead roles may require at least 10 years of experience and documented responsibility for industrialization, production development, or technical project delivery.

You Are

    Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented
    Hands-on while able to maintain a strategic perspective
    Comfortable managing several activities in parallel
    Quality-focused and committed to robust production solutions
    Communicative and effective in cross-functional environments
    Motivated by improving products, processes, and production flow
    Able to take ownership and drive activities from analysis to implementation

Education

Relevant educational backgrounds include:

    Mechanical Engineering
    Production or Manufacturing Engineering
    Industrial Engineering
    Electrical Engineering
    Mechatronics
    Automation Engineering
    Process Engineering
    Other related technical disciplines

Equivalent practical experience from advanced industrial production environments is also highly valuable.

Language and Security

Depending on the assignment, requirements may include:

    Professional communication skills in Swedish and English
    Swedish citizenship
    Ability to successfully complete a security clearance

For certain international assignments, English may be sufficient.

Applications are reviewed continuously.

We welcome both experienced engineers and senior specialists interested in future opportunities with Multiply

title: SSAB - Design Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about engineering, product development, and innovative vehicle design? We are looking for a Design Specialist to join the expert team at SSAB Knowledge Service Center.

SSAB is a globally recognized leader in advanced high-strength steels, helping automotive manufacturers build safer, lighter, and more sustainable vehicles. In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials technology, structural analysis, and forming simulation to support the development of next-generation automotive solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with customers, and using advanced simulation tools to turn innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable products.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional with strong analytical skills, deep technical expertise, and a genuine interest in product development, structural analysis, and sheet metal forming. Location: Borlänge

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

About the position 

As a Design Specialist, you will provide expert guidance on structural performance, forming feasibility, simulation methods, material behavior, and application development. Your expertise will help customers optimize components and structures for performance, manufacturability, and sustainability using SSAB’s portfolio of advanced steel grades.

You will focus on the mobility segment, developing conceptual designs, evaluating structural performance, and predicting manufacturing outcomes, often in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers.

Your daily work will include structural analyses, forming simulations, material data evaluation, method development, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

You will join a highly skilled team of steel experts who combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.  

Main responsibilities

    Develop design concepts that illustrate the benifits and applications of advanced steel grades
    Collaborate with automotive customers in designing and optimizing components and body structures  
    Perform structural analyses using finite element methods (FEM) to assess structural performance and lightweighting possibilities
    Conduct forming simulations to evaluate manufacturability and process robustness
    Develop and validate simulation methodologies, material models, and engineering workflows
    Provide customers and colleagues with technical expertise in structural performance, forming processes, material behavior, and design optimization
    Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, seminars, and presentations tailored to customers and business needs



About you

    A master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, materials engineering, engineering physics, vehicle engineering, or a related field
    At least five years of experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or engineering industry
    Solid knowledge of and experience in structural analysis and/or sheet metal forming simulation.  
    Experience using CAE tools such as LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, AutoForm, or PAM-STAMP
    Excellent written and spoken English



To thrive and succeed in this role, you should also:

    Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
    Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions
    See the big picture and connect technical details to broader business needs

title: Linux System Administrator - 19618
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Linux System Administrator is needed for a consulting assignment focused on designing, building and maintaining a GPU-enabled remote desktop and virtual desktop infrastructure environment. The platform supports high-performance remote desktops for pre-processing and post-processing of High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads, including simulation, visualization and rendering.

The environment is based on Rocky Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), with technologies including X11, Xfce4, NICE DCV, EnginFrame and SLURM. The assignment has a strong emphasis on automation, platform engineering, system architecture and long-term operational sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, deploy, operate and maintain a Linux-based GPU-enabled VDI and remote desktop environment.
    Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to enable consistent, repeatable platform deployments.
    Use Ansible primarily to automate configuration management, provisioning and operational workflows.
    Ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, high-performing and maintainable over time.
    Support remote desktop use cases for HPC-related simulation, visualization and rendering workloads.
    Collaborate closely with HPC and infrastructure engineering teams on platform design, integration and operations.
    Document solution architecture, system configurations, deployment workflows and operational procedures.
    Contribute to monitoring, observability and troubleshooting of complex Linux infrastructure environments.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Rocky Linux and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
    Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for automated deployments and configuration management.
    Bash scripting; Python is advantageous.
    Git and GitLab, including experience working with CI/CD pipelines.
    X11 and Linux desktop environments, particularly Xfce4 and GNOME.
    Remote rendering, display and visualization technologies, including NICE DCV and EnginFrame.
    Networking, infrastructure security and monitoring capabilities.
    Prometheus-based monitoring and observability tooling.
    HPC environments and the SLURM workload manager are advantageous.
    Docker, Podman and Open OnDemand are beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal consultant has solid hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator, preferably in Rocky Linux or RHEL environments. Strong experience in automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is required, ideally with Ansible or comparable tooling. The role requires proficiency in Bash scripting, while Python experience is considered beneficial.

Experience with CI/CD practices, version control, Linux graphical environments, remote display technologies, networking, security and monitoring is expected. The consultant should be capable of designing scalable, maintainable technical platforms and independently taking ownership of complex infrastructure environments. Experience supporting HPC platforms, SLURM, remote visualization solutions and container technologies is considered advantageous.

Reporting directly to the Accountable Manager, you will lead the CAMO organization and play a critical role in ensuring that all continuing airworthiness activities are conducted in accordance with EASA regulations, company requirements, and operational objectives.This is a senior leadership role with significant operational, regulatory, organizational, and strategic responsibility.

EASA Part-CAMO and EASA Air Operations regulation.Main Tasks•    Ensure the development, updating and approval of the fleet's maintenance programs.•    Ensure that all maintenance requirements from manufacturers and authorities are evaluated, implemented and accomplished within the applicable compliance limits.•    Ensure the provision and preparation of approved documentation for all maintenance, repairs and modifications carried out on the aircraft fleet.•    Ensure that the aircraft with continuing airworthiness and approved configuration of the fleet are maintained in airworthiness to the Accountable Manager or other authorized decision-making level, as applicable.Managerial Responsibility and Mandate•    Legal and organizational responsibility for the tasks within Continuing Airworthiness Management.•    Personnel responsibility for all CAMO personnel, with direct leadership responsibility for the management team.•    Delegated budget responsibility for the title: Olsaro is looking to hire a CTO
description:
Are you a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science?

Are you driven to lead R&D innovation at the intersection of biotechnology, sustainability, and food security?

OlsAro Crop Biotech is looking for a dynamic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to guide our growing team and technical vision as we tackle one of the greatest challenges of our time: feeding the world in a changing climate.

About Us

We are Olsaro Crop Biotech, a pioneering trait development and pre-breeding startup dedicated to developing solutions that empower agriculture to withstand a changing climate. Our focus is on enhancing crop resilience through innovative genetic materials, with the first focus on wheat. From tackling abiotic stresses like salinity and heat to improving nitrogen use efficiency, we are at the forefront of trait development innovation to support resilience and global food security. Having closed a successful seed funding round, we are scaling our efforts both technologically and commercially, aiming for food system resilience for future generations.

The Role: Chief Technology Officer

As our CTO, you will bring a strong background in trait development and the seed industry, taking on a central role in OlsAro’s technology journey. You will lead the R&D team, shape our platform strategy, and drive innovation across trait discovery and variety development. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving as a key member of the senior leadership team, you will have full ownership of the technology roadmap and its execution. This is a highly empowered role with significant influence over both strategic direction and day-to-day decision-making. You will work alongside the CSO as a peer. The CSO, will be responsible for advising technical expertise and setting longer term strategy as a co-founder/C-suite leader.

Your expertise will enable the rapid evelopment and scale-up of breakthrough biotech solutions, working closely with internal teams, external partners, and strategic investors.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute OlsAro’s long-term vision in trait development for cereals.

• Oversee platform development and trait development pipelines from concept to field.

• Lead, inspire, develop and expand our interdisciplinary R&D team.

• Oversee timely, budget-conscious project delivery, while managing resources effectively.

• Forge and manage high-impact collaborations with seed industry and research partners.

• Secure and manage public funding opportunities to support strategic partnerships and R&D initiatives, enabling innovation and long-term growth.

• Build data-driven infrastructure and oversee bioinformatics development.

• Integrate emerging technologies such as gene editing, molecular breeding, and AI-powered trait discovery.

• Represent OlsAro in customer, scientific, regulatory, and investment communities.

• Ensure high standards for reproducibility, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Required Qualifications

• Proven leadership experience (7+ years) in technology and R&D roles within agtech, preferably seed industry. Including a strong ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex projects.

• Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Molecular Biology, Plant Biotechnology, Computational Biology, or related field.

• Experience working in commercial trait development, breeding in a seed or trait development company.

• Proven skills in representing an organization in different communities and contexts, including driving the OlsAro tech-agenda in commercial dialogs.

• Demonstrated expertise in publicly presenting tech-driven business cases and taking part in discussions at business conferences and in scientific communities.

• Proven track record of attracting public funding for R&D and partnerships.

• Experience in trait development methodologies, molecular techniques, data integration, phenomics, and data management tools.

• Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving, communication, and decisionmaking skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach to building systems in a fastpaced startup environment.

• In-depth understanding of regulatory pathways for the commercialization of seeds and traits.

• Expertise in intellectual property development, technology licensing and scaling R&D and product platforms, preferably within startup or early-stage environments.

• Fluent in English.

Join Us

If you are a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science, then we invite you to join our journey to revolutionize crop development and to contribute to our mission of advancing climate adaptation in cereals.

Position Details

• Type: Full-time, permanent

• Start Date: From 15th of October 2026 (flexible based on candidate availability)

• Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (Medicinaregatan 9C). Physical attendance is mandatory.

• Applications will be evaluated continuously.

How to apply

Please provide your CV and cover letter outlining your qualifications and relevant experience.

Why Join OlsAro in Gothenburg, Sweden?

• Gothenburg is Sweden’s dynamic innovation hub, where world-class universities, cutting-edge startups, and a fast-growing life sciences sector come together in a vibrant, forward-looking city. Beyond its strong professional opportunities, it consistently ranks among Europe’s most livable cities, offering an exceptional quality of life, outstanding healthcare, and a well-functioning social support system. With its welcoming atmosphere, lively cultural scene, cozy cafés, coastal charm, and easy access to Sweden’s beautiful natural parcs. Enjoy the balance of urban culture and nature—with coastlines, archipelagos, forests, and hiking trails at your doorstep.

• Gothenburg is an English-friendly city, with an international community and vibrant tech and research scene

• Sweden offers a high-quality, tuition-free public education system from preschool to university. International and bilingual schools are available in Gothenburg. Sweden consistently ranks highly in international education assessments such as the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS), reflecting the strong academic foundation provided by the Swedish school system.

• Sweden is a leader in sustainability, gender equality, and family-friendly policies, making it an ideal place to build both a career and a life.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

title: Strategic Account Manager | AstraZeneca | Lernia
description:

This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

As a Strategic Account Manager at AstraZeneca in Sweden, you will play a pivotal role in transforming care projects and seeking out local and regional business opportunities. Providing value propositions aligned with stakeholder needs and objectives is essential, ultimately driving greater adherence to guideline-directed medical therapies.

Your role will involve developing and implementing local brand operational plans through cross-functional teamwork, collecting and consolidating customer insights, and informing account plans for the brand/franchise strategy.

This is a field-based position and covers the areas Värmland, Örebro, Stockholm, Södermanland and Dalarna.

We welcome new candidates that match the requirements and live in one of following regions (Stockholm, Uppsala, Örebro, Södermanland, Värmland or Västmanland).

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust account strategies to achieve commercial targets. Collaboration is key, requiring close work with the local brand team to develop tailored strategies for each account and stakeholder. Efforts will be crucial in achieving favourable brand listings, protocol inclusion, and increased brand usage through effective OMNI channel plan delivery. Leveraging data analytics, market research, and customer insights, you will identify growth opportunities and utilize tools like Veeva to track customer interactions and forecast sales. Your ability to provide value-based selling by highlighting the clinical, economic, and patient outcomes of AstraZeneca's products will be essential. Building and maintaining strategic partnerships within the therapeutic area ecosystem is a vital part of your role.

Staying informed on industry trends, market dynamics, and healthcare policies is crucial to ensure AstraZeneca remains at the forefront of the market.

Living in any of these regions: Stockholm, Uppsala, Örebro, Södermanland, Värmland or Västmanland and a Valid driver’s license is a requirement

    

Academic degree or equivalent in Business or Healthcare and minimum 3 years in healthcare sectors or pharmaceutical industry and strong understanding of the healthcare system, pharma industry, and health economics.

MGU (Medicinsk Grund Utbildning) or equivalent degree

Shown project management skills and understanding of omnichannel execution and experience of using data-driven insights to drive performance and innovative ways for long-term strategic fit (e.g NDR and Rikssvikt)

    

Excellent Swedish and English skills, with strong presentation and stakeholder influence abilities.

Personal skills:

    

Growth mindset and adaptive approach to prioritize in a dynamic environment.

    

Stong relationship building skills

    

Thrive within cross functional collaborations

    

Comfortable with digital tools Join us to drive strategic success and make a significant impact in the healthcare landscape.

Why AstraZeneca At AstraZeneca, we are on a journey to bring life-saving medicines to patients. Our role in contributing to decreasing mortality rates globally is clear. We shape the future by spotting scientifically led commercial opportunities and acting now to operationalize and scale them. Driven by the solutions we bring to the healthcare ecosystem, we make an impact at every step of the patient journey.

title: Service Delivery Specialist
description:

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Geriatrie 80-100% für die Region Döttingen gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Döttingen sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Geriatrie.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Döttingen

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Geriatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Döttingen

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Döttingen liegt in der reizvollen Landschaft des Aargaus und besticht durch seine verkehrsgünstige Lage an der Bahnlinie Zürich-Bern. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Anbindung an die Schweizer Wirtschaftszentren und gleichzeitig von der Nähe zur idyllischen Natur des Limmatals. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine harmonische Mischung aus ländlichem Charakter und urbaner Erreichbarkeit, was sie besonders für Pendler attraktiv macht.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Döttingen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Geriatrie

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Geriatrie in Döttingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Döttingen verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachkräften in der Geriatrie, da der demografische Wandel den Bedarf an qualifiziertem Personal kontinuierlich steigert. Sie profitieren als Fachperson HF/FH von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können zwischen verschiedenen Arbeitgebern wählen. yaPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler durch direkten Zugang zu geeigneten Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum und erspart Ihnen zeitaufwendige Bewerbungsprozesse, während wir Sie optimal in Ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleiten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Döttingen

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Geriatrie in Döttingen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

title: ICUS 1 – Infirmier/ère coordinateur/trice d'unité de soins
description:
Ref 2580344 \| Date: 22 Sept 2026

![Association les Châtaigniers]( )

L’Association Les Châtaigniers exploite un établissement médico\-social (EMS), une organisation d’aide et de soins à domicile (OSAD) ainsi qu’une organisation d’ergothérapie. Elle considère que la qualité des prestations repose avant tout sur les femmes et les hommes qui les rendent possibles.



Elle développe une organisation fondée sur la compétence, la responsabilité, la confiance, la transparence et l’amélioration continue. Chaque membre du personnel participe activement à une gouvernance clinique exigeante, favorisant le développement des compétences, la coopération interprofessionnelle et l'innovation organisationnelle.



L’Association inscrit l’ensemble de ses activités dans une démarche de management intégré visant à garantir la qualité des prestations, la sécurité des personnes accompagnées, la santé et la sécurité de ses collaborateurs, la protection de l’environnement et l’amélioration continue de ses pratiques.

**ICUS 1 – Infirmier/ère coordinateur/trice d'unité de soins**

En qualité d’Infirmier(ère) coordinateur(trice) d'unité de soins (ICUS), vous exercez les missions fondamentales de la profession infirmière, auxquelles s’ajoutent des responsabilités de coordination clinique, d'organisation des soins, d'encadrement des équipes et d'amélioration continue de la qualité.



Vous participez quotidiennement à la pratique clinique et à la réalisation des soins, tout en garantissant leur organisation, leur continuité, leur sécurité et leur conformité aux exigences professionnelles et institutionnelles.



Vos missions comprennent notamment :



* L’évaluation clinique des besoins en soins ;
* le raisonnement clinique ;
* la planification des interventions ;
* la coordination interprofessionnelle ;
* la réalisation des prestations infirmières ;
* la délégation et la supervision des activités de soins ;
* la documentation clinique ;
* la communication avec les résidants, les bénéficiaires, leurs proches et les partenaires du réseau ;
* la prévention et la promotion de la santé ;
* la qualité, la sécurité et la gestion des risques ;
* l’encadrement, la formation et le développement des compétences des professionnels.


**Profil recherché**



Vous êtes un·e infirmier·ère diplômé·e appelé·e à exercer une fonction d'encadrement de proximité conciliant pratique clinique, coordination des soins, organisation des prestations et développement des compétences professionnelles.



Vous répondez notamment aux conditions suivantes :



* Bachelor of Science HES\-SO en soins infirmiers, diplôme d'infirmier·ère ES ou titre suisse ou étranger permettant l'exercice de la profession en Suisse ; les titres étrangers doivent être reconnus par la Croix\-Rouge suisse conformément aux dispositions applicables ;
* autorisation de pratiquer dans le canton de Genève obtenue au plus tard à l’entrée en fonction ;
* expérience professionnelle confirmée en gériatrie dans l'accompagnement, les soins et la coordination des prestations destinées aux personnes âgées ; une expérience en psychogériatrie constitue un atout ;
* adhésion aux valeurs et au projet institutionnel de l'Association Les Châtaigniers ;
* personnalité professionnelle agile, participative, engagée, faisant preuve de discernement, de sens des responsabilités et d'un intérêt marqué pour le travail interprofessionnel ;
* aptitude démontrée à exercer un management de proximité favorisant la collaboration, le développement des compétences et la qualité des soins ;
* maîtrise des outils numériques professionnels du domaine des soins, notamment du dossier informatisé du résidant, des systèmes d'information cliniques et des outils collaboratifs ; la connaissance du modèle PLAISIR constitue un atout ;
* bonne maîtrise de l'environnement Microsoft 365, notamment Word, Excel et Outlook.


Une formation postgrade en management, gouvernance clinique, qualité, gériatrie, psychogériatrie, prévention et contrôle des infections, soins palliatifs ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent est souhaitée.



En l’absence d’une telle formation, la personne retenue s'engage à entreprendre une formation adaptée aux responsabilités du poste dans un délai convenu avec l'Association.



**Nous offrons**



Un environnement de travail interprofessionnel, au sein d’une institution à taille humaine ;



* la possibilité de contribuer activement à l’évolution des pratiques, à la qualité des soins et aux projets institutionnels ;
* des possibilités de formation continue et de développement professionnel ;
* une rémunération selon l’échelle des traitements de l’État de Genève ;
* des repas à prix préférentiel pour les collaborateurs ;
* un environnement verdoyant et agréable à Veyrier.

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Wädenswil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wädenswil – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wädenswil liegt malerisch am Zürichsee im Kanton Zürich und besticht durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung via S-Bahn sowie Buslinien. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine perfekte Balance zwischen beruflichen Chancen und hoher Lebensqualität mit direkter Seenähe. Zudem profitieren Sie von der Nähe zu Zürich und einem vielfältigen lokalen Arbeitsmarkt in innovativen Branchen.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Region Wädenswil sucht dringend qualifizierte Diplompflegefachkräfte für Akutspitäler, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen anhält und flexible Pensumlösungen zunehmend gefragt sind. Sie profitieren von hervorragenden Karrierechancen, attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihr Pensum individuell zu gestalten. iPersonal begleitet Sie als erfahrener Vermittler von der Bewerbung bis zum erfolgreichen Einstieg und nutzt seine etablierten Kontakte zu führenden Spitälern in der Region, um Ihnen schnell eine passende Stelle zu vermitteln.

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

title: Gestionnaire risques et contrôle interne
description:
Ref 2580257 \| Date: 22 Sept 2026

![Genève Aéroport]( )

Rejoignez Genève Aéroport, une ville dans la ville, où plus de 200 métiers s'activent jour et nuit pour connecter Genève et sa région au monde.

Gestionnaire risques et contrôle interne (80 \- 100%)

  

Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un environnement dynamique au cœur de multiples enjeux opérationnels, techniques et humains ?

Vous voulez contribuer à l'excellence d'un aéroport conscient des enjeux climatiques ?

Vous avez envie de rejoindre la Direction finances et services au sein du service gestion des risques et assurances pour contribuer au renforcement du dispositif de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques de Genève Aéroport ?

Alors, ce poste est fait pour vous !



**Vos responsabilités**

  

**Système de contrôle interne**

* Participer à la refonte et à la structuration du dispositif de contrôle interne
* Contribuer à l'élaboration et au déploiement du plan annuel de contrôle interne
* Identifier et formaliser les contrôles clés au sein de processus variés
* Évaluer l'efficacité des contrôles au moyen de campagnes de tests
* Analyser les écarts constatés et accompagner la mise en œuvre des actions correctives
* Collaborer avec les autres fonctions d'assurance, notamment l'audit interne et la qualité




**Gestion des incidents et retour d'expérience**

* Identifier et qualifier les incidents significatifs en lien avec les équipes concernées
* Analyser leurs causes, leurs conséquences et les limites éventuelles des mesures de maîtrise
* Formaliser les incidents et les analyses dans l'outil de gestion des risques, puis assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés
* Capitaliser sur les enseignements issus des incidents internes et externes et favoriser leur partage au sein de l'organisation


  

**Gestion des risques et sensibilisation**

* Participer à l'actualisation de la cartographie et au suivi des risques de l'organisation
* Accompagner les responsables métiers et les référents dans l'évaluation et le traitement des risques
* Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation aux risques et au contrôle interne




**Reporting et projets transversaux**

* Participer à l'élaboration du reporting consolidé des risques, des contrôles, des incidents et des plans d'action
* Exploiter et participer à l'évolution des outils de gestion des risques et du contrôle interne
* Prendre part à des projets transversaux au sein de la Direction Finances et Services








**Vous êtes** titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en gestion, finance, contrôle interne, ou d'un titre jugé équivalent dans un domaine équivalent, et vous :

* Bénéficiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou audit interne/externe ;
* Maîtrisez les outils d'analyse et de reporting et êtes à l'aise dans l'exploitation de données.
* Êtes reconnu(e) pour votre intégrité, votre rigueur, votre pragmatisme ainsi que vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse ;
* Êtes à l'aise dans les relations humaines et savez instaurer un climat de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés ;
* Êtes capable de travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs de différents niveaux hiérarchiques ;
* Faites preuve d'esprit d'initiative et êtes capable d'accompagner les métiers en formulant des recommandations pragmatiques et adaptées à leurs besoins.
* Faites preuve d'un bon esprit de collaboration et savez faire adhérer vos interlocuteurs aux démarches de maîtrise des risques et de contrôle interne.


  

**Embarquez pour une expérience unique !**

* Un cadre stimulant et innovant qui place l'excellence opérationnelle et environnementale au cœur de ses priorités pour faire grandir vos compétences.
* Une expérience unique dans une "ville dans la ville" dans un écosystème en pleine évolution, où votre travail prend une nouvelle dimension et où chaque contribution compte.
* Un environnement de travail de qualité et flexible avec des conditions de travail attractives pour le bon équilibre entre carrière et mode de vie.




**Entrée en fonction** : à convenir

**Taux d'activité** : 80% \- 100%

**Délai de postulation** : 4 octobre 2026



**Rejoignez\-nous !**

Postulez directement en ligne en transmettant un dossier de candidature complet (lettre de motivation, curriculum vitae, diplô et de travail).

Nous accepterons uniquement les dossiers complets reçus sur notre plateforme de recrutement.

Genève Aéroport garantit l'égalité des chances et s'engage en faveur de la diversité.

● Work closely with the school’s HEF Coordinator to ensure a collaborative and systematic approach to preparing our Secondary School students for university admission.

● The maintenance of personalised HEF pathways for individual students across the Secondary School
● Liaising with colleagues across schools departments (e.g. Subject Coordinators, Learning Support, Boarding, School Counsellor) to ensure that you have the whole picture of each student, aiding pathway personalisation and tailoring both Teacher and Counsellor references
● Regular, proactive consultation with students and parents to establish and refi ne HEF pathways
● Taking responsibility for country-specifi c application processes
● Leading in-house student and staff workshops

Organisation & Administration
● Supporting the HEF Coordinator in the creation and maintenance of a HEF Calendar which includes all key dates pertaining to careers, university guidance, supra-curricular / personal development opportunities
● Support in managing and updating HEF development, tracking and application systems, including (but not limited to) Unifrog, CommonApp and UCAS, ensuring that student data is kept up to date and the development of each student’s progress is closely monitored with appropriate interventions in place
● Support in coordinating and overseeing the application process in its entirety with distinct groups of students; reference-writing and collation, sourcing and uploading student transcripts, supporting all written application material (e.g. UCAS personal statement, Common App essays, US College supplementary essays, Letters of Intention etc.), uploading references and both sourcing and providing quality assurance throughout this process, ahead of fi nal submission
● Support in managing and facilitating access and support with SAT, IELTS and other HEF pathway assessments/admission tests and interview preparation, as required, including registration, portal administration and oversight of logistics, including access arrangements
● Support in arranging local and international university visits depending upon the interests of the students, in addition to ensuring our attendance at local university fairs and other events which could help to strengthen university applications
● Support in coordinating programmes of seminars, webinars and subject-specifi c workshops/ one-to-ones related to the HEF programme
● Working with the Marketing Team to promote and celebrate the HEF programme at La Garenne
● Support with the organisation of an annual ‘Futures Week’ for the Secondary School students
● Communicate regularly with families to provide application and progress updates General duties
● Ensuring your availability (on campus / remotely, as required) following the release of external examination results, supporting the analysis and evaluation of HEF pathways, liaising with colleagues, students and families as required
● Pursuing appropriate professional development, including attendance at annual conference(s) related to HEF pathways and provision
● Teaching responsibilities related to your subject area, as required by school and in consideration of the demands of the role (note that a non-teaching role may be more appropriate / preferred)
● Demonstrating a professional, friendly and respectful attitude towards all members of the La Garenne community at all times
● Assisting with other duties as assigned by the Head of Section, School Principal or General Director, in response to school needs

Expectations of all teachers
All teachers are required to carry out rota duties to ensure that students can be safely supervised across both campuses at all times and to ensure better communication beyond the classroom. As part of their commitment to school life, teaching staff members are expected to attend all events (see list below) and should be prepared to accompany children on other day or residential trips within Switzerland or beyond if required.

● Parent/Teacher Days (during the school day)
● Student parties (Halloween, Christmas & End of Year Celebration)
● Staff Christmas Party
● Supporting weekend study sessions if required (Saturday morning)
● Overnight Group Expedition (All full time Teachers should accompany once a year; 1 night 2 days) ● Boarding duties on a rota basis (if required)
● Ski Race (during the school day) and Medal Presentation Ceremony
● Charity Days (during the school day)
● School Challenge Days (usually on Sunday afternoons)
● Sports Day (during the school day)
● School Show & End of Year Ceremony (during the school day)

The Ideal Candidate
You will be an educator who is dedicated to continual improvement and embodies the attributes of the IB Learner Profi le.

● Has a good honours degree and/or a further degree
● Embraces a commitment to working within the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion
● Is passionate about their specialist teaching subject and can enthuse others
● Embraces developments and innovations in teaching and learning and is willing to experiment with new practices
● Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
● Shares the educational vision of La Garenne International School including our holistic vision of education and is excited to contribute to the co-curricular and pastoral aspects of life at the school
● Has strong interpersonal skills and can build relationships and collaborate with colleagues and the school leadership
● Has experience in dealing with university admissions
● Experience working in a boarding school setting
● A proven track record of taking initiative
● An understanding of university admissions procedures or a strong willingness to learn
● Familiarity with the IB Diploma Programme and ideally the US High School Diploma
● Possesses a positive outlook, an optimistic approach to change and development, and a good sense of humour

Benefi ts We are committed to ensuring that all of our teaching staff continue to develop themselves professionally and embrace new and innovative approaches to teaching and learning. The successful candidate will teach in our new Senior school campus, which has contemporary, bright teaching spaces equipped with the latest educational technology. The school has a range of additional benefi ts including:
● The opportunity to live and work in a beautiful area with great connections to the rest of Europe
● A safe and secure environment in which to work
● Numerous outdoor activities (particularly as Villars is a renowned ski resort)
● An opportunity to learn or improve your French
● To work in a school with an excellent reputation
● To be part of a growing school with opportunities for advancement
● Attractive working conditions
● Professional development opportunities
● Possibility to travel internationally
● Depending on availability, free tuition for staff children
● To teach in modern classrooms with the latest technology
● Approximately 15 weeks of annual holiday spread throughout the year
● Annual ski pass off ered by the school for full-time teaching staff
● Final interviews held at the school at our expense once approved by the General Director

How to apply We welcome any applicant who has a passion for education, who is ready to give each learner individual attention, participate in the life of the whole school and will uphold our guiding principles.

If this is you, please apply online via TES/Schrole or, alternatively, send:
● A complete Curriculum Vitae
● A letter of application
● A copy of your passport information page and/or Swiss work permit (if applicable)
To our Human Resources department (hr@la-garenne.ch) Chemin des Chavasses 23, 1885 Chesières Switzerland

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Pensum nach Vereinbarung für die Region Meiringen gesucht
description:
- Für ein renommiertes Haus im Gesundheitswesen in der Region Meiringen suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Meiringen – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gesundheitswesen

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Sofort

**Arbeitsort:** Region Meiringen

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen erfahren Sie im persönlichen Gespräch

Meiringen liegt im Haslital im Kanton Bern und bietet als Arbeitsort eine attraktive Kombination aus Bergregion und guter Infrastruktur. Die Region ist über die Haslibergbahn und Busverbindungen gut an das Schweizer Verkehrsnetz angebunden. Sie profitieren von der Nähe zur Natur, niedrigeren Lebenshaltungskosten als in städtischen Zentren und einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt in Tourismus und Handwerk.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Meiringen an

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Überwachung der Vitalzeichen und frühes Erkennen von Veränderungen

- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

- Zwingend für diese Stelle: Einige Jahre Berufserfahrung

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Ihre neue Wirkungsstätte

Sie arbeiten in einer etablierten Institution im Gesundheitswesen – mit einem eingespielten Team, klaren Abläufen und echter Wertschätzung. Wichtig für diese Stelle: Einige Jahre Berufserfahrung. Dabei erwartet Sie ein Umfeld, in dem Fachlichkeit und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Meiringen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, planen die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. So entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Region Meiringen verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach Diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern auf Stufe HF/FH. Sie profitieren von flexiblen Pensumsmodellen und vielfältigen Einsatzmöglichkeiten in Spitälern, Kliniken und Pflegeeinrichtungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit massgeschneiderten Positionen und begleitet Sie von der Bewerbung bis zum erfolgreichen Einstieg, um Ihnen den Berufseinstieg wesentlich zu erleichtern.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Meiringen

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Meiringen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Meiringen wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Meiringen. MediPersonal vermittelt schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

**Per E-Mail:** info@med-ipersonal.ch

**Offene Stellen:** med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/

**Spontanbewerbung:** med-ipersonal.ch/lebenslauf-hochladen/

- **Ihre Ansprechperson: Amila Bosnic**

- MediPersonal – eine Marke der MediPersonal AG · Bahnhofplatz 1C · 8304 Wallisellen

- Telefon: [044 515 57 61](tel:+41445155761) · E-Mail: [info@med-ipersonal.ch](mailto:info@med-ipersonal.ch)

description: Director of Research Director of Research ==================== 100% Quality through innovation. \*\*Your challenge\*\* At the Schulthess Clinic, research is at the heart of how we continuously improve patient care and outcomes. As Director of Research, you will bring together clinicians, researchers, the Schulthess Foundation and external partners around a shared ambition: \*\*to shape the future of orthopaedics\*\*. Working at the interface between clinical departments and research groups, you will help translate scientific excellence into better patient care, innovation and measurable impact. \* Shape and coordinate the research strategy of the Schulthess Clinic and translate our strategic priorities into a shared research agenda \* Bring together clinical departments and research groups and enable description:
Description de l’entreprise

Le Valais construit. Et nous cherchons quelqu'un qui le connaît.

Pas besoin de vous vendre le canton si vous êtes d'ici, vous savez ce que représente travailler sur des chantiers valaisans : des projets exigeants, des équipes solides, et une fierté du travail bien fait qui se transmet de chantier en chantier.

Nous sommes une agence de placement active dans toute la Suisse (28 agences), mais c'est ici, en Valais, que nous cherchons quelqu'un d'ancré. Quelqu'un qui connaît les entreprises locales, leurs façons de travailler, et qui n'a pas besoin d'apprivoiser la région avant d'être efficace.

Afin de répondre aux besoins de notre fidèle partenaire, nous recherchons un Conducteur de travaux (technicien) pour la région de Sion / Sierre.

Description du poste

Vous pilotez des chantiers de A à Z — de la phase de planification jusqu'à la remise des clés. Concrètement, cela signifie :

- Coordonner les équipes terrain, les sous-traitants et les fournisseurs
- Tenir les délais et les budgets sans perdre de vue la qualité
- Veiller à la sécurité sur le chantier, sans compromis
- Être l'interlocuteur de confiance entre la direction, les clients et les équipes
- Anticiper les problèmes avant qu'ils ne deviennent des blocages

Profil recherché

- Diplôme fédéral de conducteur de travaux
- Brevet fédéral de chef d'équipe et/ou contremaître, un vrai plus
- Une expérience solide sur des chantiers en Suisse, idéalement en Valais
- Le sens du terrain : vous avez probablement commencé comme maçon ou contremaître, et ça se voit dans votre manière de travailler
- Une communication directe et un leadership naturel — les équipes vous suivent parce qu'elles vous font confiance

Nous offrons

Les entreprises avec lesquelles nous travaillons en Valais ont bonne réputation, et ce n'est pas un hasard. Vous intégrez un environnement où le métier est respecté et où votre expérience a de la valeur dès le premier jour.

- Poste fixe avec un salaire à la hauteur de votre expertise
- Perspectives réelles d'évolution et de formation continue
- Un réseau d'entreprises partenaires solides dans la région
- Et bien sûr vous travaillez là où vous vivez

title: Critical Infrastructure Mechanical Engineer, Field Engineering
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
* Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.
* Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget
* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

**Key job responsibilities
**

You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

**About the team
**

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


**Diverse Experiences
**

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


**Work/Life Balance
**

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**Inclusive Team Culture
**

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


**Mentorship and Career Growth
**

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken English
* Willing to travel between Data Center sites, and internationally if required
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Experience with mission critical facilities engineering including but not limited to the following sectors: data centers, power generation, oil & gas facilities. (Experienced Engineer).
Preferred qualifications
* Possess data analytics skills, data querying skills/language, scripting, and comfort with working in vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
* Direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers.
* Experience as resident engineer or hands-on (in the field) design consultant or owner’s engineer.
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region. Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents.
* Ability to carry design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment/mass production.
* Basic understanding of both mechanical and/or electrical equipment/design related to data centers (Including but not limited to: uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switch gear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, fans, air economizers, water treatment, etc...).
* EPMS/SCADA/BMS Controls system experience (software and/or hardware)
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken German and English
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
